items.title_en: Depth-Aware Path Planning and Collision Avoidance for Robotic Nursing Assistants Using Real-Time 3D Vision
items.title_zh: 基于实时3D视觉的机器人护理助手深度感知路径规划与避障
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a depth-aware path planning and collision avoidance framework for the safe navigation of robotic nursing assistants in cluttered environments with low-height obstacles. Conventional LiDAR-based navigation systems, while accurate for mapping and localization, fail to detect transparent or low-height obstacles, whereas vision-based systems are prone to noise and occlusion. The proposed framework integrates RGB-D depth sensing, rule-based obstacle avoidance, and the NavfnROS global path planner to drive the robot from an initial point to a goal point. The proposed approach is implemented on the Husky A200 robot, equipped with a Kinova Gen3 arm, to form a complete setup for a robotic nursing assistant. This system features a multi-layer architecture for global planning, perception fusion, and real-time control in the ROS-Gazebo environment. Experimental evaluations in a simulated cluttered environment demonstrate up to 40\% higher success rate and 35\% improvement in minimum clearance compared with single-sensor baselines. Furthermore, real-world experimental results validate the proposed approach as a computationally efficient and safety-aware navigation solution for autonomous healthcare robots.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种深度感知的路径规划与避障框架，用于机器护理助手在含低矮障碍物的杂乱环境中安全导航。传统LiDAR导航虽建图与定位准确，却难以检测透明或低矮障碍；视觉系统则易受噪声和遮挡影响。该框架集成RGB-D深度传感、基于规则的避障和NavfnROS全局路径规划器，驱动机器人从起点到达目标点。作者在配备Kinova Gen3机械臂的Husky A200机器人上实现完整护理助手设置，并在ROS-Gazebo环境中采用多层架构完成全局规划、感知融合与实时控制。仿真实验表明，与单传感器基线相比，成功率最高提升40%，最小间隙改善35%；真实实验验证了该方法计算高效且具备安全感知能力。
items.highlight_zh: RGB-D融合规则避障提升护理机器人低矮障碍导航安全
items.digest_zh: 这篇论文关注医院或护理场景中，机器人助手如何在拥挤且存在低矮、透明障碍物的走廊里安全移动。问题在于：LiDAR建图定位准，却容易漏掉透明或贴地障碍；纯视觉又受噪声、遮挡干扰。作者把RGB-D深度相机、基于规则的局部避障和NavfnROS全局路径规划结合起来，让机器人从起点规划到目标点，并在ROS-Gazebo中搭建全局规划、感知融合和实时控制的多层系统。硬件平台是Husky A200移动底座加Kinova Gen3机械臂，构成护理助手原型。仿真对比显示，该多传感器融合方案相较单一传感器基线，任务成功率最高提高40%，最小安全间隙改善35%；真实环境实验也表明计算开销可控、导航更安全。其意义在于为自主医疗机器人提供一种兼顾实时性与安全性的导航思路，尤其补足低矮和透明障碍检测短板。
items.comment: 12 pages, 14 figures

rm.usage: 可借鉴其RGB-D深度感知、规则避障与NavfnROS全局规划的流程，作为哨兵在RM场地中对低矮结构（场边台阶、场地外沿）这类激光雷达容易漏检障碍的补充检测思路；需在赛场传感器与算力条件下重做验证，不能当成可直接上场的完整导航系统。

items.title_en: RangeNav: Task-Aligned LiDAR Range-Image Pretraining for Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: RangeNav：面向机器人导航的任务对齐 LiDAR 距离图像预训练
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots operating in dense crowds and cluttered sites require $360^\circ$ perception to react to surrounding hazards. While panoramic LiDAR offers full-surround coverage, learning representations within reinforcement learning (RL) is sample-inefficient under sparse rewards, and existing 3D pretrained point-cloud encoders are too memory-heavy for massively parallel RL simulation. We present RangeNav, a compact (183k parameters) LiDAR range-image encoder pretrained entirely on synthetic data. RangeNav uses anisotropic convolutions and circular padding to handle the extreme aspect ratio and azimuthal seam of range images. We pretrain the network using a navigation-aligned objective combining range reconstruction, semantic segmentation, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) prediction, then freeze it for policy learning. In simulation, adding semantic and BEV supervision increases success rates over a reconstruction-only baseline by an average of 32.03 and 23.73 percentage points (pp) in procedurally generated training and out-of-distribution realistic test environments, respectively. Zero-shot real-world deployments on a Unitree B2-W quadruped demonstrate robust navigation through dense crowds, low-light settings, and construction zones where limited-field-of-view depth policies struggle. Code and models will be open-sourced. Project website: https://rangenav.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 在密集人群与杂乱场地中作业的自主移动机器人需要 360° 感知来应对周围危险。全景 LiDAR 可提供全向覆盖，但在稀疏奖励下用强化学习（RL）学习表征样本效率低，现有 3D 预训练点云编码器对大规模并行 RL 仿真而言显存开销又过大。为此我们提出 RangeNav：一个仅 183k 参数、完全在合成数据上预训练的紧凑 LiDAR 距离图像编码器，采用各向异性卷积与循环填充处理距离图像极端的宽高比与方位角接缝，并以结合距离重建、语义分割与鸟瞰图（BEV）预测的导航对齐目标预训练，随后冻结用于策略学习。仿真中，相较仅重建基线，加入语义与 BEV 监督使成功率在程序化训练环境和分布外真实感测试环境中分别平均提升 32.03 与 23.73 个百分点。Unitree B2-W 四足机器人上的零样本实机部署表明，该方法在密集人群、低光与施工区域中导航稳健，而有限视场的深度策略在这些场景中表现不佳。
items.highlight_zh: 183k 参数距离图像编码器，语义+BEV 预训练显著提升导航成功率
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：在拥挤人群、杂乱工地里跑的四足/移动机器人，需要 360° 环视才能及时避开危险。全景 LiDAR 能给全向覆盖，但直接用强化学习从零学感知表征，在稀疏奖励下极耗样本；现成的 3D 点云预训练编码器又太占显存，撑不起动辄上千个并行环境的 RL 训练。
- 用了什么方法：作者把 LiDAR 数据转成“距离图像”（像把一圈激光测距展开成一张二维图），设计只有 18.3 万参数的小编码器 RangeNav。因为这张图特别“扁”（方位角极大、俯仰角极小），左右两端其实相连，他们用各向异性卷积（横竖方向感受野不同）和循环填充处理宽高比与接缝。预训练全用合成数据，目标特意“对齐导航”：不只重建距离，还要预测语义分割和鸟瞰图（BEV）。训练好就冻结编码器，再学 RL 策略。
- 得到什么结果：在程序生成的训练场景和分布外真实感测试场景中，相比只用重建的基线，加入语义与 BEV 监督使成功率分别平均提高 32.03 和 23.73 个百分点。在 Unitree B2-W 四足机器人上零样本部署，可在密集人群、低光、施工区穿行，而视场受限的深度策略在这些场景频繁失败。
- 为何重要：说明“小模型 + 任务对齐的自监督预训练”足以让全向 LiDAR 在真实机器人上稳定落地，省算力、省样本，也让大规模并行 RL 训练变得可行。
items.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Added project website to abstract and updated author affiliation; research content unchanged

rm.usage: 轻量LiDAR距离图像编码器（183k参数）用重建+语义+BEV预训练后冻结接RL策略，可作为哨兵360°激光感知的预训练骨干，减少仿真样本量；但需自建RM场地仿真与奖励函数，不能直接部署。

items.title_en: GGraph: A GPU-Accelerated Library for Graph-Based Robot Deployment and Learning
items.title_zh: GGraph：面向机器人部署与学习的 GPU 加速图库
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots require spatial representations that capture geometry and semantics while staying sparse enough for planning in large, unknown environments. Graphs provide a natural representation for this purpose and underpin both classical planning methods and a growing class of reinforcement-learning (RL) policies. However, RL training needs hundreds to thousands of parallel environments, each constructing and updating its own graph. Existing graph libraries are typically designed for either single-robot deployment or fixed graphs, and CPU-based graph construction limits scalable training to only a few dozen environments. We introduce GGraph, an open-source GPU-accelerated graph library for both robot deployment and large-scale learning. GGraph supports real robots through ROS 2 interfaces and vectorized GPU-based policy training, with built-in support for tasks including 3-D navigation, exploration, and loop-closure integration. For single-robot operation, GGraph updates graphs in milliseconds. At scale, it enables graph-based exploration policies to train across hundreds of parallel robots, reducing wall-clock training time by one order of magnitude. Across simulation and real-world experiments, these results establish GGraph as a unified graph infrastructure for both large-scale robot learning and deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人需要既能捕捉几何与语义、又足够稀疏以支撑大型未知环境中规划的空间表征。图为此提供了自然表示，既支撑经典规划方法，也支撑日益增多的强化学习（RL）策略。然而 RL 训练需要成百上千个并行环境，每个环境都要构建并更新自己的图；现有图库多面向单机器人部署或固定图，且基于 CPU 的图构建使可扩展训练只能限于数十个环境。我们提出 GGraph，一个开源的 GPU 加速图库，同时服务机器人部署与大规模学习：它通过 ROS 2 接口支持真实机器人，提供向量化的 GPU 策略训练，并内置三维导航、探索与回环检测集成等任务支持。单机器人运行时图更新为毫秒级；规模化时，基于图的探索策略可在数百个并行机器人上训练，将实际训练时间缩短一个数量级。仿真与真实实验共同表明 GGraph 可作为机器人学习与部署的统一图基础设施。
items.highlight_zh: GPU 加速图库，支持数百并行机器人图策略训练，耗时降一个数量级
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：机器人在未知大环境里规划，需要一种既包含几何又包含语义、同时保持稀疏的表示，图结构正好合适，经典规划与图强化学习都依赖它。但 RL 训练要成百上千个并行环境，每个环境各自建图、更新图；现有图库要么只考虑单个真实机器人部署，要么假设图是固定的，而且建图多在 CPU 上完成，并行规模只能到几十个环境。
- 用了什么方法：作者做了 GGraph，一个开源的 GPU 加速图库，一套代码同时覆盖“部署”和“训练”：对真实机器人提供 ROS 2 接口；对训练提供向量化的 GPU 并行建图与策略学习。内置三维导航、探索、回环检测（loop closure）融合等常见任务支撑。
- 得到什么结果：单机器人运行时，图更新在毫秒级；规模化时，基于图的探索策略可同时在数百个并行机器人上训练，把实际训练耗时缩短一个数量级（约十倍）。仿真与真实实验都验证了这一点。
- 为何重要：过去“训练用的图”和“部署用的图”是两套东西，图构建还是训练吞吐的瓶颈。GGraph 把它统一到 GPU 上，让图这一经典表示也能享受大规模并行 RL 的红利。
items.comment: 9 pages, 11 figures

rm.usage: GPU加速的图结构库，可在仿真侧加速哨兵大量并行环境的图构建与探索策略训练，或作为ROS2下基于图的规划基础设施；属训练与工程工具，不含任何RM战术策略。

items.title_en: DIVAL: Diffeomorphic Vector-Field Alignment for Nonholonomic Motion Planning
items.title_zh: DIVAL：面向非完整运动规划的微分同胚向量场对齐
items.abstract_en: Conventional vector-field-based motion planners for nonholonomic robots consist of two steps: first designing a nominal vector field and then controlling the robot to follow it to approach the target. However, a nonholonomic robot cannot follow the vector field instantaneously and may collide with obstacles, due to the inevitable mismatch between the robot's initial heading and the vector field's direction. This paper proposes a diffeomorphic vector-field alignment (DIVAL) method, which aligns the vector field's direction with the robot's initial heading so the robot can follow the vector field from the start. Specifically, the nominal vector field is locally reshaped by applying a diffeomorphic deformation to the workspace, such that the reshaped vector field has the same direction as the robot's heading at the initial position and coincides with the nominal vector field outside the deformed region. Since DIVAL eliminates the initial heading mismatch, the nonholonomic robot can maintain heading alignment with the reshaped vector field throughout the motion. This heading alignment further ensures that the robot preserves the nominal vector field's properties, including obstacle avoidance, convergence to the target, and smooth control signals. Numerical simulations provide vector-field-tracking baselines where the nominal vector fields are reshaped with DIVAL. Compared to the original baselines, the proposed method achieves collision-free convergence in all trials and avoids control discontinuities. Hardware experiments on a ground vehicle further demonstrate collision-free convergence across different targets and initial conditions under real-world disturbances.
items.abstract_zh: 传统基于向量场的非完整机器人规划先设计名义向量场，再控制机器人跟随。但机器人无法瞬时跟随向量场，且初始航向与场方向失配可能导致碰撞。本文提出微分同胚向量场对齐（DIVAL）：对工作空间施加微分同胚变形以局部重塑名义向量场，使其在初始位置与机器人航向同向，变形区外保持不变。DIVAL消除了初始航向失配，使机器人全程保持航向对齐，从而保留避障、收敛与光滑控制特性。仿真和地面车辆实验表明，该方法在所有试验中实现无碰撞收敛，避免控制不连续，并在不同目标、初始条件和真实扰动下有效。
items.highlight_zh: 用微分同胚变形对齐初始航向，实现非完整机器人无碰撞收敛
items.digest_zh: 这篇论文关注非完整机器人（如不能横移的地面车辆）如何沿向量场安全到达目标。传统做法是先设计一个指向目标的“箭头场”，再让机器人跟随；但机器人有转向限制，起步时车头方向常与箭头方向不一致，若强行跟随，可能在转向过程中撞上障碍。作者提出DIVAL：不改变机器人，而是“扭一扭”整个空间——用微分同胚变形局部重塑向量场，让起点处的箭头方向恰好与车头一致，而远离起点处仍保持原向量场。这样机器人从第一步就能顺着场走，全程保持航向对齐，并继承原向量场的避障、收敛和平滑控制性质。仿真中，把DIVAL套用到现有向量场跟踪基线上，所有试验都实现了无碰撞到达，且控制信号不再跳变；真实地面车辆实验也在不同目标、初始位姿和扰动下成功避障并收敛。其意义在于把“初始航向失配”这一常见工程隐患从源头消除，为受限机器人提供了一种无需重设计全局向量场的轻量对齐思路。
items.comment: 19 pages, 12 figures, under review

rm.usage: 用微分同胚形变把向量场与初始朝向对齐的非完整约束规划方法，对解决哨兵起步朝向与目标方向不一致时的平滑绕障有思路价值；但RM哨兵多为全向底盘，非完整假设适配性需重新评估，且仅为仿真与小车实验。

items.title_en: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
items.title_zh: 面向工业环境的移动操作机器人技术报告
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 Shahid Beheshti 大学机器人与智能自动化实验室为 Auriga Robotics 开发的工业移动操作机器人 @Work Robot 的设计与实现。该平台面向重复或危险工业任务，采用四轮 Mecanum 驱动实现全向移动，配备 5 自由度机械臂和 3D 打印夹爪。电子系统包括基于 ESP32 的定制 PCB 与负责高层处理和实时控制的 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX。软件采用 Hector SLAM 建图定位、A* 路径规划和 YOLO 实时目标检测，并融合传感器数据实现稳健导航与避障。系统在类工业环境中的自主导航、物体操作和任务执行中展现出良好的软硬件集成与稳定性能。
items.highlight_zh: 集成Hector SLAM、A*与YOLO的工业移动操作平台
items.digest_zh: 这篇技术报告要解决的问题是：工业环境中存在大量重复、危险或劳动强度高的工作，需要能自主移动并操作物体的机器人平台。作者设计并实现了 @Work Robot：底盘采用四轮 Mecanum 驱动，可全向移动；上部是 5 自由度机械臂和 3D 打印夹爪，用于抓取和操作。电子系统用基于 ESP32 的定制 PCB 板连接底层设备，并用 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 承担高层计算和实时控制。软件栈包括 Hector SLAM 做建图与定位、A* 做路径规划、YOLO 做实时目标检测，再把多传感器数据融合起来，支撑导航和避障。报告的结果是系统在类工业场景中能完成自主导航、物体处理和任务执行，性能较稳定，说明软硬件集成方案可行。其意义在于为工业重复/危险作业的自动化提供了一个可落地的移动操作机器人参考平台，并展示了感知、规划与执行模块协同工作的完整链路。
items.comment: 25 pages, 22 figures, 4 tables. Technical report of Team Auriga's 2025 mobile manipulator (@Work) platform (Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Shahid Beheshti University)

items.title_en: Omni-IGN: Onboard Image-Goal Navigation for Drones with Omnidirectional Vision
items.title_zh: Omni-IGN：面向无人机的全向视觉机载图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation (ImageNav) requires an agent to reach a location specified by a goal image in an unknown environment. For drones, this task demands exploration, goal- directed navigation, and collision avoidance under limited onboard computing resources. Existing aerial ImageNav methods are built on single-view observations, requiring additional rotation and exploration to search for goal-relevant cues outside the field of view. In this paper, we present Omni-IGN, a fully onboard ImageNav system that integrates quad-fisheye perception, an attention-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy, and a collision-aware safety layer. The policy adaptively fuses goal-relevant features across multiple views to provide directional guidance for continuous navigation. The quad-fisheye RGB images support both ImageNav and obstacle avoidance without a dedicated depth sensor. On Habitat benchmarks, Omni-IGN achieves the best performance among continuous-action baselines. Moreover, flight tests in IsaacSim validate the effectiveness of integrating learning-based depth estimation with the action safety layer for collision avoidance. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer without any fine-tuning or external localization. The code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体在未知环境中抵达由目标图像指定的位置。对无人机而言，该任务需在有限机载算力下同时完成探索、目标导向导航与避障。现有空中 ImageNav 方法基于单视图观测，需要额外旋转与探索才能找到视野外的目标相关线索。本文提出 Omni-IGN，一个完全机载的 ImageNav 系统，融合四鱼眼感知、基于注意力的强化学习（RL）策略与碰撞感知安全层。策略自适应融合多视图中的目标相关特征，为连续导航提供方向引导；四鱼眼 RGB 图像同时支持 ImageNav 与避障，无需专用深度传感器。在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中表现最佳；IsaacSim 飞行测试验证了学习式深度估计与动作安全层结合用于避障的有效性；真实世界实验则展示了无需微调或外部定位的零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。
items.highlight_zh: 四鱼眼全向视觉+注意力 RL+安全层，实现无人机零样本真机导航
items.digest_zh:
- 研究了什么问题：图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体只看一张目标照片，就在陌生环境里走到那个位置。对无人机更难：要在机载有限算力下同时完成探索、朝目标飞和避障。现有空中方案多为单视图，视野外的目标线索只能靠原地转圈和额外探索去找，效率低。
- 用了什么方法：作者提出 Omni-IGN，一个全部跑在机上的系统，由三部分组成：四个鱼眼相机组成的全向 RGB 感知（不装专用深度传感器）、基于注意力的强化学习策略、以及碰撞感知的安全层。策略自适应地在多个视角间融合目标相关特征，输出连续控制指令；同一套鱼眼图像既用于导航也用于判断障碍。安全层借助基于学习的深度估计对动作做碰撞过滤。
- 得到什么结果：在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中表现最好。IsaacSim 飞行测试验证了“学习式深度估计 + 动作安全层”确实能有效避障。真机实验中实现了零样本 sim-to-real：不微调、也不用外部定位系统就能飞行。
- 为何重要：全向视觉让无人机“看一眼就够”，省掉了为扩大视野而做的机动与探索；把安全层与学习策略解耦，也使仿真训练的策略更容易迁移到真机，对算力受限的机载平台尤其有意义。

rm.usage: 四路鱼眼+注意力RL策略+碰撞安全层的全机载ImageNav，可参考其无外部定位、无专用深度传感器的机载视觉导航与避障，用于空中机器人离库后按目标图像飞向指定区域或返航；但方案不含机库精确降落对接、可见光链路与裁判系统约束，需大幅改造，室内小场地与机载算力也需实测。

items.title_en: Sim-to-Real Room-Mediated Object-Goal Navigation with ROS 2 and Nav2
items.title_zh: 基于ROS 2与Nav2的仿真到真实房间介导目标物体导航
items.abstract_en: Although object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) approaches are usually evaluated in simulation, which offers scale and repeatable environments, real-world deployments are rarely examined beyond feasibility demonstrations. This paper presents the deployment of Room-Mediated Co-occurrence, an ObjectNav policy that reasons over Room Probability Vectors (RPVs), on two robotic platforms (Boston Dynamics Spot and Clearpath Robotics TurtleBot 4) through a robot-agnostic ROS 2 bridge. We study how these semantic priors generalise to physical environments and describe the adaptations required to transfer RPV from simulation to hardware, covering sensing, localisation, and the action interface. Across 66 trials on Spot, searching for 11 object categories from two starting positions in a university postgraduate research facility, RPV achieves a raw Success Rate (SR) of 0.455. Our analysis identifies undetected glass walls, entry into off-limits areas, limited usable depth range, target size, and mismatch between the room lexicon and physical layout as plausible contributors to the 8.4 percentage-point gap between the real-world SR and the reported simulated SR of 0.539. Code is available at https://github.com/Matthew-K-Chua/rpv-ros2-bridge.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管目标物体导航（ObjectNav）方法通常在仿真中评估，仿真提供了规模化且可重复的环境，但真实世界部署很少在可行性演示之外得到检验。本文介绍通过机器人无关的ROS 2桥接，将Room-Mediated Co-occurrence（一种基于房间概率向量（RPV）推理的ObjectNav策略）部署到两个机器人平台（Boston Dynamics Spot和Clearpath Robotics TurtleBot 4）上。我们研究这些语义先验如何泛化到物理环境，并描述将RPV从仿真迁移到硬件所需的适配，涵盖传感、定位和动作接口。在Spot上的66次试验中，在大学研究生研究设施内从两个起始位置搜索11个物体类别，RPV取得0.455的原始成功率（SR）。我们的分析指出，未被检测到的玻璃墙、进入禁区、可用深度范围有限、目标尺寸，以及房间词库与物理布局之间的不匹配，可能是真实世界SR与报道的仿真SR 0.539之间8.4个百分点差距的促成因素。代码见https://github.com/Matthew-K-Chua/rpv-ros2-bridge。
items.comment: 9 pages. Accepted to ACRA (Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation) 2026

rm.usage: ROS2+Nav2上ObjectNav的实机落地及仿真-实机差距分析，对哨兵按语义目标搜索敌方或区域有一点参考，但依赖房间级语义先验，RM为单一已知场地，迁移收益有限。

items.title_en: APG-Planner: Learning Vision-Based High-Speed Trajectory Planning via Analytic Policy Gradient
items.title_zh: APG-Planner：通过解析策略梯度学习基于视觉的高速轨迹规划
items.abstract_en: Vision-based high-speed navigation requires a trajectory planner that can reactively generate smooth, collision-free trajectories from onboard visual observations. Deep reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to vision-based trajectory planning, as it enables the optimization of sequential decision-making policies in complex environments. However, model-free policy gradient methods rely on sample-based policy gradient estimation, which yields noisy gradient estimates and inefficient training. To this end, we propose a framework for learning trajectory planning policies using the analytic policy gradient (APG) method and use it to train APG-Planner, a vision-based high-speed trajectory planner. The proposed framework leverages differential flatness to analytically reconstruct vehicle states from planned trajectories, thereby enabling differentiable trajectory-level state transitions without requiring an explicit low-level dynamics model. By iteratively performing trajectory planning and differentiable state transitions, we construct a differentiable episode rollout and analytically compute policy gradients from episode-level losses, improving both training efficiency and policy performance. After approximately 30 minutes of training on a single GPU, APG-Planner demonstrates comparable or superior performance to existing baseline methods in simulation and achieves speeds of up to 11\,m/s in real-world flight experiments. We further validate the proposed framework on a skid-steer ground robot, demonstrating its applicability to differentially flat robotic systems beyond quadrotors.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的高速导航需要一种轨迹规划器，能够从机载视觉观测中反应式地生成平滑、无碰撞的轨迹。深度强化学习为基于视觉的轨迹规划提供了一种有前景的方法，因为它能够在复杂环境中优化序贯决策策略。然而，无模型策略梯度方法依赖于基于采样的策略梯度估计，这会产生带噪声的梯度估计并导致训练效率低下。为此，我们提出一个使用解析策略梯度（APG）方法学习轨迹规划策略的框架，并用其训练APG-Planner——一种基于视觉的高速轨迹规划器。所提框架利用微分平坦性，从规划轨迹中解析地重建车辆状态，从而无需显式低层动力学模型即可实现可微的轨迹级状态转移。通过迭代执行轨迹规划与可微状态转移，我们构建可微的回合展开，并从回合级损失中解析计算策略梯度，从而同时提高训练效率和策略性能。在单块GPU上训练约30分钟后，APG-Planner在仿真中表现出与现有基线方法相当或更优的性能，并在真实飞行实验中达到最高11 m/s的速度。我们进一步在滑移转向地面机器人上验证了所提框架，表明其可适用于四旋翼之外的微分平坦机器人系统。

rm.usage: 用解析策略梯度从机载视觉直接生成高速避障轨迹，可迁移到空中机器人的轻量机载感知-规划一体方案（同文也验证了滑移转向底盘）；但需自建仿真与训练流程，且不涉及机库交互、起降对接与通信限制，真实速度上限也需按场地与安全要求裁剪。

items.title_en: OASIS: Optimization-Aware Subgoal Inference with Safety Constraints for Autonomous Mobile Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: OASIS：面向自主移动机器人导航的安全约束优化感知子目标推断
items.abstract_en: Navigation in dynamic environments requires mobile robots to make progress toward their goals while respecting motion limits and avoiding surrounding obstacles. Learned subgoal policies can guide model predictive control beyond its local prediction horizon, but a geometrically suitable subgoal does not necessarily lead to a successfully solved control problem. This paper proposes OASIS, a hierarchical navigation framework that incorporates recent optimization outcomes into reinforcement learning-based subgoal generation. A high-level policy trained using Soft Actor--Critic generates local subgoals, while a nonlinear model predictive controller tracks them subject to motion limits, geometric collision-avoidance constraints, and embedded high-order control barrier function constraints. The outcomes of controller optimizations over each subgoal interval are summarized and provided to the policy at its next decision, without requiring additional optimization calls. The framework is evaluated in five navigation scenarios with static and moving obstacles, including dense interactions and sensing uncertainty. Comparisons with hierarchical and direct-goal control variants show that OASIS achieves the highest aggregate navigation success. Matched comparisons across three training seeds further show a consistent success advantage over the otherwise identical hierarchy without optimization-status input. The selected-policy comparison also shows fewer primary optimization failures with similar mean controller time.
items.abstract_zh: 动态环境中的导航要求移动机器人在遵守运动限制并避开周围障碍的同时朝目标推进。学习到的子目标策略可以引导模型预测控制超越其局部预测时域，但几何上合适的子目标并不一定带来成功求解的控制问题。本文提出OASIS，一种将近期优化结果纳入基于强化学习的子目标生成的层次化导航框架。使用Soft Actor–Critic训练的高层策略生成局部子目标，而非线性模型预测控制器在运动限制、几何避碰约束和嵌入式高阶控制屏障函数约束下跟踪这些子目标。每个子目标区间内控制器优化的结果被总结，并在下一次决策时提供给策略，而无需额外优化调用。该框架在五个具有静态和移动障碍物的导航场景中评估，包括密集交互和感知不确定性。与层次化和直接目标控制变体比较，OASIS获得最高的总体导航成功率。在三个训练种子上的匹配比较进一步表明，相对于没有优化状态输入的其余相同层次结构，其具有一致的成功率优势。所选策略比较还显示，在相似的平均控制器时间下，主要优化失败更少。

rm.usage: 把「RL 生成子目标 + MPC 跟踪并带 CBF 避障约束」的分层结构借到哨兵全自动导航中：高层策略在场地动态对抗下给出局部子目标，底层用带安全约束的 MPC 跟踪，并把优化求解状态回灌策略以减少卡死。需在 RM 场地几何、100W 底盘和自身算力下重新训练与验证，不能直接当成品。

items.title_en: RAVEN: A Unified Active SLAM System for Rapid Autonomous Visual Exploration with Aerial Robots under Localization Uncertainty
items.title_zh: RAVEN：面向空中机器人在定位不确定性下快速自主视觉探索的统一主动 SLAM 系统
items.abstract_en: Active simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) addresses the problem of planning robot motion to build complete and accurate maps of unknown environments through efficient exploration while maintaining high localization accuracy. This raises a dilemma between exploring unknown spaces to expand coverage and exploiting visited regions to perform active loop closures. Despite numerous prior works on ground robots, aerial robots with high agility and constrained sensor suites face more significant localization drift and thereby demand dedicated active SLAM planning. Moreover, a unified strategy that adapts performance based on task-specific priorities remains an open question. In this article, we introduce RAVEN, a unified active SLAM framework for Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN using quadrotors, which systematically accounts for localization uncertainty. The framework starts with identifying frontiers and active loop closure candidates, from which global tour candidates are generated. These candidates are evaluated using a utility vector that separately quantifies exploration efficiency and localization accuracy, and the final tour is selected according to a prioritization parameter ranging from $[0,1]$. Finally, a perception-aware navigation planner generates smooth execution trajectories that minimize visual state estimation error based on the online Fisher information field that provides visual localization information in real-time. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that RAVEN outperforms state-of-the-art active SLAM methods, highlighting its advantages in producing a spectrum of performance across prioritizations. Fully onboard field experiments with a customized stereo-inertial quadrotor further validate its practical applicability in challenging environments. The source code will be released to benefit the community.
items.abstract_zh: 主动同时定位与建图（SLAM）解决的是通过高效探索规划机器人运动，以在未知环境中构建完整、准确地图并保持高定位精度的问题。这带来了在探索未知空间以扩大覆盖与利用已访问区域进行主动回环闭合之间的两难。尽管地面机器人已有大量先前工作，但具有高敏捷性和受限传感器配置的空中机器人面临更显著的定位漂移，因而需要专门的主动 SLAM 规划。此外，能够根据任务特定优先级自适应调整性能的统一策略仍是一个开放问题。本文提出 RAVEN，一个用于四旋翼快速自主视觉探索（Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN）并系统考虑定位不确定性的统一主动 SLAM 框架。该框架首先识别前沿和主动回环闭合候选，并由此生成全局巡游候选。这些候选通过一个分别量化探索效率和定位精度的效用向量进行评估，最终巡游依据取值范围为 [0,1] 的优先级参数进行选择。最后，感知感知导航规划器基于实时提供视觉定位信息的在线 Fisher 信息场，生成使视觉状态估计误差最小化的平滑执行轨迹。基准评测表明 RAVEN 优于当前最先进的主动 SLAM 方法，凸显其在不同优先级下产生一系列性能表现的优势。使用定制立体-惯性四旋翼进行的完全机载现场实验进一步验证了其在挑战性环境中的实际适用性。源代码将发布以惠及社区。
items.comment: Conditionally accepted to the IEEE Transactions on Robotics

rm.usage: 其主动 SLAM 的「探索收益/定位精度」加权评估与感知感知（Fisher 信息场）轨迹规划，可参考用于空中机器人在无外部动捕条件下的室内视觉定位漂移抑制与起降、返航路径规划，也可借签到哨兵的定位退化处理。属于方法级参考，需按赛场光照、纹理稀疏与机载算力改造，非可直接部署系统。

items.title_en: TravSUITE: Traversability via Self-Supervised, Uncertainty-Aware IRL and Terrain Estimation
items.title_zh: TravSUITE：基于自监督、不确定性感知IRL与地形估计的可通行性
items.abstract_en: Traversability analysis in off-road settings remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robots. Key difficulties include constructing an accurate and expressive local map from multimodal sensor data, and using the map to design traversability rules that yield desirable navigation behavior. Importantly, this system must be resilient to the limited sensing regime brought about by complex environments and high speeds. In this paper, we present TravSUITE, a traversability system suitable for high-speed navigation in off-road environments. TravSUITE consists of two major components: 1) an efficient voxel mapper that leverages visual foundation models (VFMs) to build a rich geometric-semantic local map from streams of on-board sensor data, and 2) a unified neural network that jointly predicts traversability-relevant quantities in bird's eye view (BEV), including geometry, semantics, speed and cost. Our training strategy is entirely annotation-free and self-supervised, leveraging tasks such as map inpainting and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) to learn both map representations and traversability. We perform a thorough ablation study and comparison to state-of-the-art approaches, and the results indicate that cost learning and auxiliary inpainting each contribute significantly to planning quality, and their combination is critical for achieving state-of-the-art performance in off-road path planning. We also design a simple risk adaptation mechanism to leverage our method's uncertainty estimates at deploy-time, and demonstrate that a combination of inpainting and risk estimation can result in 80% fewer navigation errors and 5% faster autonomous traversal speeds in real-world hardware experiments.
items.abstract_zh: 越野环境中的可通行性分析仍然是移动机器人的一项基本挑战。关键困难包括从多模态传感器数据构建准确且具有表现力的局部地图，以及利用该地图设计可产生理想导航行为的可通行性规则。重要的是，该系统必须能够适应复杂环境和高速度带来的有限感知条件。本文提出TravSUITE，一种适用于越野环境高速导航的可通行性系统。TravSUITE由两个主要部分组成：1）高效体素建图器，利用视觉基础模型（VFM）从车载传感器数据流构建丰富的几何-语义局部地图；2）统一神经网络，在鸟瞰图（BEV）中联合预测与可通行性相关的量，包括几何、语义、速度和代价。我们的训练策略完全无需标注且为自监督，利用地图修复和逆强化学习（IRL）等任务同时学习地图表示和可通行性。我们进行了全面的消融研究并与最先进方法比较，结果表明代价学习和辅助修复各自对规划质量有显著贡献，二者的结合对于在越野路径规划中达到最先进性能至关重要。我们还设计了一种简单的风险适应机制，以在部署时利用该方法的不确定性估计，并证明在真实硬件实验中，修复与风险估计的结合可使导航错误减少80%，自主通行速度提高5%。

rm.usage: 面向越野环境的高速可通行性分析与不确定性风险自适应，与 RM 室内平整场地、结构化赛道的导航需求基本不符，关联很弱。

items.title_en: Recon2Servo: Robotic Ultrasound Visual Servoing via Learned Image-to-Motion Inference
items.title_zh: Recon2Servo：通过学习的图像到运动推断实现机器人超声视觉伺服
items.abstract_en: Ultrasound visual servoing is essential for autonomous robotic ultrasound, yet 6-DoF probe control from 2D B-mode images remains challenging due to limited and ambiguous out-of-plane motion cues. Existing methods typically rely on anatomical priors or handcrafted visual features, limiting their generalizability across imaging targets. Inspired by trackerless 3D ultrasound reconstruction, we propose Recon2Servo, a visual servoing framework that learns image-to-motion inference directly from B-mode images for 6-DoF probe control. A DINOv3 encoder with low-rank adaptation and a bidirectional relation module estimate the relative probe pose between current and target images to guide iterative closed-loop target-view alignment. The framework combines supervised relative-pose learning, reconstruction-guided closed-loop adaptation, and bounded residual pose correction to improve motion inference during servoing. Evaluations on a public dataset and an in-house dataset collected from 12 healthy volunteers using different ultrasound systems demonstrate its effectiveness in reconstructed-volume servoing. Additional real-robot demonstrations of target-view alignment and dynamic tracking on a human forearm are provided in the supplementary video: https://youtu.be/qwsOdI-GMYk.
items.abstract_zh: 超声视觉伺服对于自主机器人超声至关重要，然而由于有限且模糊的平面外运动线索，从二维B模式图像进行6自由度探头控制仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖解剖先验或手工设计的视觉特征，限制了其在不同成像目标间的泛化能力。受无跟踪器三维超声重建启发，我们提出Recon2Servo，一个直接从B模式图像学习图像到运动推断以进行6自由度探头控制的视觉伺服框架。一个带有低秩适应的DINOv3编码器和一个双向关系模块估计当前图像与目标图像之间的相对探头位姿，以引导迭代闭环目标视图对齐。该框架结合监督式相对位姿学习、重建引导的闭环适应和有界残差位姿校正，以改善伺服过程中的运动推断。在公共数据集和使用不同超声系统从12名健康志愿者采集的内部数据集上的评估表明，其在重建体积伺服中的有效性。补充视频中还提供了在人体前臂上进行目标视图对齐和动态跟踪的真实机器人演示：https://youtu.be/qwsOdI-GMYk。

rm.usage: 超声 B 模式图像到探针六自由度运动的视觉伺服，与重装识别科技核心视觉标签、估计刚体位姿的成像方式差异过大，最多借鉴其「相对位姿回归 + 有界残差闭环修正」的伺服结构，实用性低。

items.title_en: Sample-Efficient Model Predictive Control via Proximal Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: 通过近端策略优化实现样本高效的模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) enables real-time control of complex nonlinear systems but often incurs substantial computational costs due to repeated trajectory simulations. In this paper, we bridge policy optimization in reinforcement learning and sampling-based MPC to improve computational efficiency through sample reuse. Starting from a KL-regularized distributional formulation of trajectory optimization, we derive an exact performance-difference identity based on a signed exponential advantage function. This identity motivates two algorithms, PPO-MPPI and SPO-MPPI, which adapt proximal policy optimization techniques to sampling-based MPC, enabling multiple optimization updates using previously evaluated trajectories without additional forward simulations. We establish population-level monotonic improvement guarantees for both methods and prove convergence to first-order stationarity for PPO-MPPI under fixed-covariance Gaussian sampling distributions. Experiments on quadruped velocity tracking and quadrotor path tracking demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve competitive control performance at substantially lower computational cost than multi-stage sampling approaches. Our results establish a principled connection between policy optimization and sampling-based MPC and highlight the potential of trajectory reuse for sample-efficient predictive control.
items.abstract_zh: 基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）能够对复杂非线性系统进行实时控制，但由于重复轨迹仿真，通常会产生大量计算成本。本文将强化学习中的策略优化与基于采样的MPC联系起来，通过样本复用来提高计算效率。从轨迹优化的KL正则化分布形式出发，我们推导出基于带符号指数优势函数的精确性能差恒等式。该恒等式启发了两种算法PPO-MPPI和SPO-MPPI，它们将近端策略优化技术适配到基于采样的MPC，使得能够利用先前评估过的轨迹进行多次优化更新，而无需额外的前向仿真。我们为两种方法建立了群体层面的单调改进保证，并在固定协方差高斯采样分布下证明了PPO-MPPI收敛到一阶平稳性。在四足机器人速度跟踪和四旋翼路径跟踪上的实验表明，所提方法以显著低于多阶段采样方法的计算成本实现了有竞争力的控制性能。我们的结果在策略优化与基于采样的MPC之间建立了有原则的联系，并突出了轨迹复用于样本高效预测控制的潜力。

items.title_en: Embedded Sim-to-Real Visual Servoing: Learned Reaching and Force-Guided Placement
items.title_zh: 嵌入式仿真到现实视觉伺服：学习式接近与力引导放置
items.abstract_en: Embedded perception-to-control systems must combine visual targeting with reliable contact handling under tight computational constraints. We present a shared architecture on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin controlling a Franka Research 3 through Cartesian impedance control. RealSense D435i observations, YOLO11-seg segmentation, depth back-projection, and hand--eye calibration provide metric robot-frame targets. We compare two strategies: compact proximal policy optimization (PPO) policies transferred from simulation for object- and hole-region reaching, and force-guided Cartesian placement using approximately 2 N normal contact and spiral search. The PPO policies achieved 87.2% and 83.1% success over 1000 simulation episodes each. Across 50 real-robot trials per strategy, the learned hybrid and force-guided analytical pipelines achieved 70.0% and 74.0% completion, respectively. Mean perception latency with TensorRT was 34.55 ms. These results support an embedded architecture combining learned free-space reaching with explicit contact correction.
items.abstract_zh: 嵌入式感知到控制系统必须在严格的计算约束下，将视觉目标定位与可靠的接触处理相结合。我们提出一种在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上通过笛卡尔阻抗控制操纵Franka Research 3的共享架构。RealSense D435i观测、YOLO11-seg分割、深度反投影以及手眼标定提供机器人坐标系下的度量目标。我们比较两种策略：从仿真迁移而来的紧凑近端策略优化（PPO）策略，用于物体区域和孔洞区域的接近；以及使用约2 N法向接触和螺旋搜索的力引导笛卡尔放置。PPO策略在各自1000个仿真回合上的成功率为87.2%和83.1%。在每种策略50次真实机器人试验中，学习式混合流程和力引导分析流程分别达到70.0%和74.0%的完成率。使用TensorRT的平均感知延迟为34.55 ms。这些结果支持一种将学习式自由空间接近与显式接触校正相结合的嵌入式架构。
items.comment: 6 pages. Accepted at IEEE ROBIO 2026

rm.usage: 嵌入式平台上的分割+深度反投影+手眼标定得到目标位姿，配合力引导接触对位（螺旋搜索、接触力阈值），可参考用于重装机械臂对接 42mm 发射机构/能量单元时的视觉伺服与末段接触修正。但其为 Jetson+Franka 架构，需按实际机械臂、工装与算力重做标定与策略迁移。

items.title_en: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
items.title_zh: 教一棵树恢复：利用反事实回放的LLM监督器在线蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人通常将全局规划器与局部模型预测控制器（MPC）配对，但非凸避障和有限时域可能导致机器人在复杂布局中冻结。决定是重新规划、等待还是求助，是一项监督决策。近期工作在每个异常发生时都查询大语言模型（LLM）监督器，这既慢又昂贵。我们改为将LLM在线蒸馏为决策树。在每个训练回合后，反事实回放将恢复操作标注为需要、不必要或有害。这些标签会淘汰无用的规则。在仿真中，对于仅靠MPC会冻结的20个未见布局，该决策树在所有随机种子下至少正确处理18个，要么到达目标，要么在不存在可行路径时求助。该决策树与始终查询的LLM监督器和专家设计的规则均相匹配，同时在测试时不发出任何LLM查询。手写规则无法预见物理机器人将遇到的长尾情况。在线蒸馏是一种有前景的补救方法：决策树处理熟悉情况，仅对新情况咨询LLM，而经过验证的恢复操作会成为新规则。因此，语言模型也可以充当监督器的设计者，而不仅是运行时监督器。

rm.usage: 把「重规划/等待/请求支援」的监督决策从 LLM 在线查询蒸馏为轻量决策树，可借鉴到哨兵被卡死或路径不可行时的运行时监督模块；但需自建 RM 仿真回放与标签流程，论文本身不含 RM 场景与已验证策略，收益有限。

items.title_en: Integrating Flow Matching and Model Predictive Control for Safe Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 集成流匹配与模型预测控制的安全机器人导航
items.abstract_en: Learning-based path planners based on diffusion and flow matching can generate diverse trajectories from demonstrations but typically lack mechanisms for constraint satisfaction and collision avoidance during deployment. This work proposes a framework that combines flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive path-following control to integrate data-driven path generation with real-time, constraint-aware execution. The flow-matching model captures multimodal path distributions, while the predictive controller adapts motion online to satisfy state and input constraints and avoid obstacles using updated local sensor information. An event-triggered re-planning scheme incorporates predictive control solutions into subsequent path generation, promoting collision-free navigation in environments with previously unseen obstacles. Simulation results for mobile robot navigation demonstrate robust performance across cluttered environments. The framework provides a systematic approach to combining flow matching with predictive control for adaptive, data-driven navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于扩散和流匹配的学习型路径规划器可以从演示中生成多样化轨迹，但通常缺乏部署期间满足约束和避免碰撞的机制。本文提出一个将基于流匹配的路径规划与模型预测路径跟随控制相结合的框架，以将数据驱动的路径生成与实时、约束感知的执行相结合。流匹配模型捕获多模态路径分布，而预测控制器在线调整运动，以满足状态和输入约束，并利用更新的局部传感器信息避障。事件触发重规划方案将预测控制解纳入后续路径生成，促进在存在先前未见障碍物的环境中的无碰撞导航。移动机器人导航的仿真结果表明在杂乱环境中具有稳健性能。该框架提供了一种系统化方法，将流匹配与预测控制相结合，用于自适应、数据驱动的导航。

rm.usage: 用流匹配生成多模态路径、再用 MPC 做约束跟随的思路，可借鉴到哨兵导航中「学习型路径生成 + 实时避障执行」的分层结构；但论文仅在移动机器人仿真中验证，缺少 RM 场地实机与嵌入式算力证据，只能作为架构参考，不能直接替代现有 Nav2/自研规划器。

items.title_en: EasyNav: A Modular Architecture for Real-Time Navigation Across Heterogeneous Robot Environments
items.title_zh: EasyNav：面向异构机器人环境的实时导航模块化架构
items.abstract_en: Most robot navigation stacks implicitly bind mapping, localization, planning, and control to specific representations and data flows, yielding architectures hard to extend, compare experimentally, or reason about end-to-end timing. This is critical in heterogeneous scenarios, where multiple spatial representations, sensing modalities, and coordinate frames coexist and evolve at different rates. This paper presents a navigation architecture centered on an explicit, shared navigation state that serves as the sole interaction interface between modular components. Constraining mapping, localization, planning, and control to operate over this shared state enables interchangeable, representation-agnostic pipelines under explicit compatibility and timing contracts. We realize this architecture as EasyNav, an open source ROS 2 framework, and validate it through real-robot experiments, including indoor navigation with laser sensing and large-scale indoor-outdoor navigation with GPS and 3D LiDAR across multi-level routes. Compared with Nav2 under matched conditions, EasyNav reduces reaction latency from 377 to 33 ms indoors and from 71 to 8 ms outdoors, while also using less CPU and memory.
items.abstract_zh: 大多数机器人导航栈会将建图、定位、规划和控制隐式绑定到特定表示和数据流，从而产生难以扩展、难以进行实验比较或难以对端到端时序进行推理的架构。这在异构场景中尤为关键，因为多种空间表示、传感模态和坐标框架共存并以不同速率演化。本文提出一种以显式共享导航状态为中心的导航架构，该状态作为模块化组件之间唯一的交互接口。将建图、定位、规划和控制约束为在该共享状态上运行，可在明确的兼容性与时序契约下实现可互换、与表示无关的流水线。我们将该架构实现为开源 ROS 2 框架 EasyNav，并通过真实机器人实验进行验证，包括使用激光传感的室内导航，以及使用 GPS 和 3D LiDAR 在多层路线上进行的大规模室内外导航。在匹配条件下与 Nav2 相比，EasyNav 将室内反应延迟从 377 ms 降至 33 ms，将室外反应延迟从 71 ms 降至 8 ms，同时使用更少的 CPU 和内存。
items.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/EasyNavigation

items.title_en: VisGeo-PipeTrack: A Visual Geometric Servo Control Framework with MPC-RCAPID Control for UAV-Based Dynamic Pipes Tracking
items.title_zh: VisGeo-PipeTrack：一种基于MPC-RCAPID控制的无人机动态管道跟踪视觉几何伺服控制框架
items.abstract_en: While unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for pipeline inspection, prevailing research predominantly assumes static pipes. In real-world industrial environments, pipes often exhibit dynamic movements, such as vibrations. This imposes more stringent requirements on UAVs' adaptive control and computational efficiency than in static scenarios. Therefore, this paper proposes a servo control framework named VisGeo-PipeTrack, which utilizes geometric constraints to enable UAV tracking of dynamic pipes. To achieve efficient UAV positioning, YOLOv5 is employed to detect labels on the pipe. The positions are derived from visual geometric constraints based on these detected labels to enable precise localization. To address tracking control challenges, a model predictive control based real-time corrected adaptive PID (MPC-RCAPID) controller is proposed. This controller employs the Recursive Least Squares method for real-time model estimation and integrates rolling horizon optimization to dynamically adjust PID parameters. Experiments conducted on both the AirSim simulator and the Tello UAV platform validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Simulation comparisons with standard PID, fractional-order PID, adaptive PID, and fuzzy PID demonstrate that MPC-RCAPID achieves the shortest settling time (3.26 s) and the lowest average tracking error (3.52%). In physical experiments on the Tello platform, compared with standard PID control, MPC-RCAPID reduces the average tracking error by 55.52%, 26.72%, and 26.52% across the three test dimensions. These results demonstrate that VisGeo-PipeTrack facilitates efficient autonomous tracking in dynamic pipe environments.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管无人机（UAV）越来越多地被部署用于管道巡检，但现有研究大多假设管道是静态的。在实际工业环境中，管道常常表现出动态运动，例如振动。与静态场景相比，这对无人机的自适应控制和计算效率提出了更严格的要求。因此，本文提出了一种名为VisGeo-PipeTrack的伺服控制框架，利用几何约束使无人机能够跟踪动态管道。为实现高效的无人机定位，采用YOLOv5检测管道上的标签。基于这些检测到的标签，通过视觉几何约束推导位置，以实现精确定位。为应对跟踪控制挑战，提出了一种基于模型预测控制的实时校正自适应PID（MPC-RCAPID）控制器。该控制器采用递归最小二乘法进行实时模型估计，并结合滚动时域优化动态调整PID参数。在AirSim仿真器和Tello无人机平台上进行的实验验证了所提框架的有效性。与标准PID、分数阶PID、自适应PID和模糊PID的仿真对比表明，MPC-RCAPID实现了最短的调节时间（3.26 s）和最低的平均跟踪误差（3.52%）。在Tello平台上的物理实验中，与标准PID控制相比，MPC-RCAPID在三个测试维度上分别将平均跟踪误差降低了55.52%、26.72%和26.52%。这些结果表明，VisGeo-PipeTrack有助于在动态管道环境中实现高效的自主跟踪。
items.comment: Submit to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems IEEE TITS

items.title_en: Natural-Language to Nav2: Operational Policies for Costmap-Based Navigation
items.title_zh: 自然语言到Nav2：基于代价地图导航的操作策略
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots support material transport in warehouses and industrial facilities, where navigation must adapt to changing operating conditions. Sensor observations reveal physical obstacles, but do not by themselves specify temporary access rules, route preferences, or exceptions known to operators. This paper presents a natural-language policy interface that brings this knowledge into ROS 2 Nav2. A local large language model converts instructions into JSON policies specifying destinations, spatial constraints, and temporal or event conditions. Deterministic checks govern mission acceptance, and three costmap adapters project accepted policies into the existing navigation stack without changing its planner or controller. On 150 researcher-authored English commands, four local models produce 107-142 correct accepted policies, compared with 44 for a rule-based parser, with 3-20 incorrect acceptances per model. Fault injection records rejection of eight endpoint/JSON faults and 29 validator-stage faults. Navigation experiments use correct task policies to evaluate keepouts, zone costs, person-dependent regions, and event-conditioned passage in simulation and on a TurtleBot3. For Tasks 1-3, mean travel times are 18.4-24.5% lower in simulation and 23.1-35.0% lower on the physical testbed than with the baseline lacking those policies. A native KeepoutFilter comparison and two-robot demonstrations examine basic keepout behavior and shared policy projection. The interface connects operator instructions to explicit navigation policies while retaining Nav2's planning and control components.
items.abstract_zh: 自主移动机器人支持仓库和工业设施中的物料运输，在这些场景中，导航必须适应不断变化的运行条件。传感器观测可揭示物理障碍，但其本身并不规定操作人员已知的临时通行规则、路径偏好或例外情况。本文提出一种自然语言策略接口，将这些知识引入ROS 2 Nav2。一个本地大语言模型将指令转换为JSON策略，指定目的地、空间约束以及时间或事件条件。确定性检查控制任务是否被接受，三个代价地图适配器将接受的策略投影到现有导航栈中，而不改变其规划器或控制器。在150条由研究人员编写的英文命令上，四个本地模型生成107-142条正确且被接受的策略，而基于规则的解析器为44条；每个模型有3-20条错误接受。故障注入记录了八个端点/JSON故障和29个验证器阶段故障被拒绝。导航实验使用正确的任务策略，在仿真和TurtleBot3上评估禁行区、区域代价、依赖人员的区域以及事件条件通行。对于任务1-3，与缺少这些策略的基线相比，仿真中的平均行驶时间降低18.4-24.5%，物理测试平台上的平均行驶时间降低23.1-35.0%。一项原生KeepoutFilter比较和两个机器人演示考察了基本禁行区行为和共享策略投影。该接口将操作人员指令连接到显式导航策略，同时保留Nav2的规划与控制组件。
items.comment: 23 pages, 16 figures, including supplementary material. Jiyeong Chae and Hyunkyo Seo contributed equally. Project page: https://a56239637-dot.github.io/Natural-Language-to-Nav2-Project-Page/

items.title_en: Drone Navigation for Fast, Safe Emergency Response
items.title_zh: 面向快速、安全应急响应的无人机导航
items.abstract_en: In 2025, there was a total of 358 weather-related disasters worldwide affecting millions of people. For unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to autonomously aid these people, they need to be able to navigate around complex obstacles and reach their destinations to deliver supplies or quickly locate survivors in disaster-stricken areas. Our research addresses this need by providing a method to compute minimum-time trajectories in real time while providing guarantees of obstacle avoidance along the trajectory. Previous approaches treat the problem of computing time-optimal trajectories without considering obstacle avoidance. Our work not only includes obstacle avoidance constraints, but also improves overall mission time for navigation. We define mission time as the sum of planning time and traversal time. In time-sensitive emergencies, rapid trajectory planning is essential to ensure the prompt delivery of critical medical aid. As such, we consider the combined planning and traversal time as the key metric for how quickly the vehicle can reach a survivor. We show a sample mission in Fig. 1 where the quadrotor navigates through multiple canyon-like obstacles to deliver aid; during most of this trajectory, it is applying the near-maximum thrust.
items.abstract_zh: 2025 年全球共发生 358 起与天气相关的灾害，影响数百万人。为使无人机（UAV）能够自主帮助这些人，它们需要能够绕过复杂障碍并到达目的地，以运送物资或在受灾地区快速定位幸存者。我们的研究通过提供一种实时计算最短时间轨迹的方法来满足这一需求，同时保证沿轨迹避障。以往方法在处理时间最优轨迹计算问题时未考虑避障。我们的工作不仅包含避障约束，还改善了导航的总体任务时间。我们将任务时间定义为规划时间与通行时间之和。在时间敏感的紧急情况下，快速轨迹规划对于确保关键医疗援助的及时送达至关重要。因此，我们将规划与通行时间之和视为衡量飞行器多快能到达幸存者的关键指标。图 1 展示了一个示例任务，其中四旋翼飞行器穿过多个峡谷状障碍物以运送援助；在该轨迹的大部分过程中，飞行器施加接近最大推力。
items.comment: Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

items.title_en: BEV-Diffusion: Camera-Only Traversability Navigation with BEV Memory and Efficient Cross-Robot Adaptation
items.title_zh: BEV-Diffusion：具有BEV记忆和高效跨机器人适应的纯相机可通行性导航
items.abstract_en: Robot navigation requires both an understanding of the scene and an efficient adaptation to new robots, yet current methods rely on expensive LiDAR sensors, long mapping and modular pipelines. We present BEV-Diffusion, a camera-only model that learns a bird's-eye view (BEV) traversability map, its uncertainty and the path in a single network. A frozen DINOv2 backbone encodes consecutive RGB frames, which inverse perspective mapping and Bayesian fusion lift into the BEV, and a ranking loss keeps outdoor traversability graded rather than binary, separating asphalt from grass (median 0.94 vs. 0.75). On this map, a transformer denoiser generates polar waypoints in a few DDIM steps, and uncertainty-aware guidance refines the path and ends it where the map is no longer reliable. At deployment, a metric BEV memory keeps obstacles after they leave the camera view and warm starts each sample from the previous, ego-motion compensated path. Because the planner jointly learns the path, the map, and its uncertainty, it selects routes through terrain it can confidently traverse. In an unseen courtyard, a wheeled-legged robot autonomously traveled 120 m, completing 96% of the route without intervention, compared with 75-88% for the baselines. Even under low-light conditions after sunset, the proposed model completed the route without requiring any intervention. Retraining only the BEV head, about 3% of the parameters, adapts the model to a small legged robot in 2.3 min. Indoors, the memory gets this robot out of maze-like traps: it retains 62-66% of the nearby out-of-view obstacles, against at most 3% for the baselines, and the robot achieves 67-100% task progress, compared with 20-40% for the evaluated baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人导航既需要理解场景，也需要高效适应新机器人，然而当前方法依赖昂贵的LiDAR传感器、长时间建图和模块化流程。我们提出BEV-Diffusion，一种仅使用相机的模型，在单一网络中学习鸟瞰图（BEV）可通行性地图、其不确定性以及路径。冻结的DINOv2主干网络对连续RGB帧进行编码，逆透视映射和贝叶斯融合将其提升到BEV中，排序损失使室外可通行性保持分级而非二值，将沥青与草地分开（中位数0.94对0.75）。在该地图上，Transformer去噪器在少量DDIM步骤中生成极坐标路点，不确定性感知引导细化路径，并在地图不再可靠处终止路径。在部署时，度量BEV记忆在障碍物离开相机视野后仍保留它们，并用先前经自运动补偿的路径热启动每个样本。由于规划器联合学习路径、地图及其不确定性，它选择通过其能够自信穿越的地形的路线。在一个未见过的庭院中，轮腿机器人自主行驶了120 m，在无干预情况下完成了96%的路线，而基线为75-88%。即使在日落后低光照条件下，所提模型也无需任何干预即完成了路线。仅重新训练BEV头（约3%的参数），即可在2.3分钟内使模型适应小型足式机器人。在室内，该记忆使该机器人摆脱迷宫式陷阱：它保留了62-66%的附近视野外障碍物，而基线至多为3%，机器人达到67-100%的任务进度，而所评估基线为20-40%。

items.title_en: Navigating Robots from Unknown and Uncalibrated Exocentric Cameras via Map Estimation
items.title_zh: 通过地图估计从未知且未标定的外置相机导航机器人
items.abstract_en: Exocentric cameras, mounted on walls or ceilings in indoor environments, offer wider vantage points and are less easily occluded than robot-mounted cameras, making them an appealing alternative for perception in robot navigation algorithms. Previous methods that use such cameras, however, require their pose and intrinsics to be known before deployment, demanding calibration that is time-consuming, requires specialized personnel, and must be repeated whenever a camera moves or a new room is navigated. We propose Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras (ROMUX), an agent that navigates a robot toward point goals while avoiding obstacles using exocentric cameras that are both uncalibrated, meaning the system does not require their pose or intrinsic information as input, and unknown, meaning it is not fit to a specific camera during training and does not require pre-deployment fine-tuning. We train a cross-view transformer on large-scale simulation data to predict metric robot-centric obstacle maps from exocentric images, without conditioning image tokens on camera information. A small policy trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) then navigates on the predicted maps toward a goal coordinate relative to the robot. We benchmark our agent in simulation with cameras randomized per episode, and it matches the success rates of a PPO policy that navigates from a robot-mounted camera. Further, ROMUX works with one camera or multiple cameras with partial views and has been transferred zero-shot to a real robot using a camera at varying positions and orientations across various room layouts.
items.abstract_zh: 安装在室内环境墙壁或天花板上的外置相机提供更宽的视角，且比机器人搭载相机更不易被遮挡，因此成为机器人导航算法中颇具吸引力的感知替代方案。然而，先前使用此类相机的方法要求部署前已知其位姿和内参，这需要耗时、需专业人员且每当相机移动或导航新房间时必须重复的标定。我们提出ROMUX（Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras），一种智能体，利用既未标定（即系统不要求将其位姿或内参信息作为输入）又未知（即训练期间不针对特定相机拟合，且不需要部署前微调）的外置相机，引导机器人朝向点目标导航并避开障碍物。我们在大规模仿真数据上训练跨视图Transformer，从外置图像预测以机器人为中心的度量障碍物地图，而不将图像token以相机信息为条件。随后，一个用近端策略优化（PPO）训练的小型策略在预测地图上朝相对于机器人的目标坐标导航。我们在每个回合随机化相机的仿真中对该智能体进行基准测试，其成功率与从机器人搭载相机导航的PPO策略相匹配。此外，ROMUX可适用于一个相机或多个具有部分视图的相机，并已零样本迁移到真实机器人上，在不同房间布局中使用位置和方向变化的相机。
items.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures

items.title_en: RESCUE Jumper: A Centimeter-Scale Rolling and Jumping Robot for Search and Rescue
items.title_zh: RESCUE Jumper：用于搜救的厘米级滚动与跳跃机器人
items.abstract_en: Centimeter-scale robots are promising for urban search and rescue because they can enter confined spaces that are inaccessible or unsafe for humans. However, their small size limits obstacle traversal after deployment. This paper presents the RESCUE Jumper, a 125 g mobile robot with a 6.2 cm width and 6.2 cm diameter wheels that combines ground rolling with jumping to traverse steps and gaps that exceeds its rolling capability. The RESCUE Jumper uses its two actuators for both rolling mode and jumping by reversing the direction of wheel motion. Forward wheel motion enables rolling, while reverse wheel motion winds a spring steel tail to store elastic potential energy and release it for jumping. The RESCUE Jumper varies tail winding speed to control jump direction, transitioning from backward to forward jumps as winding speed increases from 0.75 rad/s to 8.73 rad/s. The launch angle of the jumps ranges from 45 degree to -11 degree with respect to the vertical axis, reaching a maximum height of 9.2 cm and a maximum lateral displacement of 11.2 cm. We model the winding speed-dependent jumping behavior in three phases: tail release to determine the contact point and robot orientation, tail straightening until liftoff, and ballistic flight to predict jump height and lateral displacement. Finally, qualitative tests highlight the robot's locomotion in cluttered, real-world environments. The model and experiments presented in this work can inform future designs of space-constrained jump mechanisms in centimeter-scale robots for search and rescue and inspection in unstructured environments.
items.abstract_zh: 厘米级机器人有望用于城市搜救，因为它们可以进入人类无法到达或不安全的狭窄空间。然而，其小尺寸限制了部署后的越障能力。本文提出RESCUE Jumper，一种125 g的移动机器人，宽6.2 cm，轮径6.2 cm，结合地面滚动与跳跃，以穿越超出其滚动能力的台阶和间隙。RESCUE Jumper通过反转轮子运动方向，将两个执行器同时用于滚动模式和跳跃。轮子正向运动实现滚动，而反向运动卷绕弹簧钢尾以储存弹性势能并释放用于跳跃。RESCUE Jumper通过改变尾部卷绕速度来控制跳跃方向，随着卷绕速度从0.75 rad/s增加到8.73 rad/s，跳跃从向后跳转为向前跳。跳跃发射角相对于垂直轴的范围为45度至-11度，达到最大高度9.2 cm和最大横向位移11.2 cm。我们将依赖卷绕速度的跳跃行为建模为三个阶段：尾部释放以确定接触点和机器人姿态，尾部伸直直至离地，以及弹道飞行以预测跳跃高度和横向位移。最后，定性测试突出了该机器人在杂乱真实环境中的运动能力。本文提出的模型和实验可为未来用于非结构化环境中搜救和检查的厘米级机器人空间受限跳跃机构设计提供参考。
items.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics 2026, Best Paper Award

items.title_en: DGV-DLIVO: Degeneracy-Guided Visual Fusion for Direct LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry in Degenerate Tunnel Environments
items.title_zh: DGV-DLIVO：退化引导的视觉融合，用于退化隧道环境中的直接激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: Reliable localization in long underground infrastructures remains a major challenge for autonomous inspection robots. In hydropower spillway tunnels and drainage galleries, repetitive geometric structures provide insufficient constraints along the tunnel axis, while weak texture and illumination variations further degrade visual estimation. Under this coupled degradation, existing LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial odometry systems may lose the ability to recover continuous longitudinal motion. This paper presents DGV-DLIVO, a degeneracy-guided visual fusion for direct LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry for extreme tunnel environments. Instead of treating vision as a general complementary sensor, the proposed method exploits the LiDAR-degenerate direction as an active guidance signal to determine informative visual regions, establish LiDAR-anchored visual associations, and perform subspace-selective fusion. The visual constraints are introduced only into the deficient motion subspace, while unreliable LiDAR information in the same direction is adaptively suppressed and reliable geometric constraints are preserved. Real-world experiments in hydropower tunnels demonstrate that representative state-of-the-art LIO, LIVO, and VIO methods suffer from stagnation, oscillation, severe under-travel, curved drift, or divergence, whereas DGV-DLIVO maintains continuous and directionally consistent tunnel-axis motion estimation under both cart-mounted and handheld acquisition. It achieves a 91.4% progress ratio over the 40m tunnel sequence and significantly improves longitudinal recovery and trajectory stability. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of degeneracy-guided adaptive fusion for robotic inspection in severely degraded underground environments. The source code and a supplementary video are publicly available at https://github.com/0RayZhang0/DGV-DLIVO.
items.abstract_zh: 在长距离地下基础设施中实现可靠定位仍是自主巡检机器人面临的主要挑战。在水电站泄洪隧洞和排水廊道中，重复的几何结构沿隧道轴向提供的约束不足，而弱纹理和光照变化进一步降低视觉估计性能。在这种耦合退化条件下，现有激光雷达-惯性里程计和视觉-惯性里程计系统可能丧失恢复连续纵向运动的能力。本文提出 DGV-DLIVO，一种面向极端隧道环境的退化引导视觉融合直接激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计。该方法不将视觉视为一般互补传感器，而是利用激光雷达退化方向作为主动引导信号，以确定信息丰富的视觉区域、建立以激光雷达为锚的视觉关联，并执行子空间选择性融合。视觉约束仅引入到不足的运动子空间中，同时同一方向上不可靠的激光雷达信息被自适应抑制，可靠几何约束得以保留。在水电站隧洞中的真实实验表明，代表性的先进 LIO、LIVO 和 VIO 方法会出现停滞、振荡、严重欠行程、弯曲漂移或发散，而 DGV-DLIVO 在推车安装和手持采集下均保持连续且方向一致的隧道轴向运动估计。在 40 m 隧道序列上，DGV-DLIVO 达到 91.4% 的进度比，并显著改善纵向恢复和轨迹稳定性。这些结果证明了退化引导自适应融合在严重退化地下环境中用于机器人巡检的有效性。源代码和补充视频公开于 https://github.com/0RayZhang0/DGV-DLIVO。

items.title_en: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification
items.title_zh: A2A-UAV：用于无人机检测与识别的多模态空对空数据集
items.abstract_en: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）在低空空域的快速增长增加了未经授权入侵的风险，使得对非合作无人机的可靠检测与识别对低空空域安全至关重要。然而，现有公开无人机数据集大多从固定地面视角采集，且仅限于成像或射频（RF）观测，这限制了传感覆盖范围和部署灵活性。为填补这一空白，我们提出 A2A-UAV，一个用于无人机检测与识别的多模态空对空数据集。具体而言，使用搭载 RGB-热成像云台相机、全景相机、RF 频谱分析仪和毫米波雷达的无人机平台，在三个室外站点于白天和夜间条件下记录了 13 种商用型号的 15 架目标无人机。该数据集包含 105,294 个时间对齐的 RGB、全景、热成像和 RF 时频图像样本以及雷达点云。此外，所有 209,539 个以小型无人机目标为主的边界框均经人工标注和交叉核验。因此，A2A-UAV 为低空空域中的空对空无人机检测、识别和多模态融合提供了有价值的资源。
items.comment: 27 pages, 9 figures

items.title_en: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
items.title_zh: 面向自主移动机器人的视觉-语言接地语义导航
items.abstract_en: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导导航使移动机器人能够解释自然语言命令，并在非结构化环境中朝用户指定目标导航。然而，将开放词汇视觉感知与用于建图和导航的经典机器人流水线集成仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。在这项工作中，我们提出一个完整的基于 ROS2 的系统，它结合基于前沿的探索、使用 Grounding DINO 的开放词汇目标检测、基于深度的三维定位和语义建图，以在仿真中实现端到端视觉-语言接地导航。该系统接受诸如“go to the yellow box”之类的自然语言命令，使用文本提示从 RGB 图像中检测候选对象，估计它们在世界坐标系中的位置，并生成由 Nav2 栈执行的导航目标。在配备 TurtleBot3 机器人的基于 Gazebo 的室内环境中，该系统自主探索了房间，检测到五个目标对象中的三个，并成功执行了所测试的两条自然语言导航命令，且无需任务特定训练。结果表明，开放词汇接地模型可以集成到经典导航流水线中，但性能受到检测不确定性、基于深度的定位误差和不完整探索覆盖的限制。这些发现凸显了使用轻量级、仅 CPU 架构部署视觉-语言接地导航系统的可行性与当前局限性。
items.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures

rm.usage: 开放词汇检测 + 语义地图 + Nav2 的语言导航空栈，与 RM 固定场地、固定目标类别的导航需求错位，工程量和检测不确定性都不划算；至多可借鉴其「语义地图分区域代价」的工程组织方式。

items.title_en: Distilling Safety Filters for Filter-free Multi-agent RL
items.title_zh: 面向无滤波器多智能体强化学习的安全滤波器蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can teach robot teams to navigate shared spaces, but trial and error causes collisions that real robots cannot afford. Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters prevent these collisions by correcting unsafe actions, yet in a team the filter becomes a centralized optimization whose number of constraints grows quadratically with the team size. We propose an approach that builds the filter's safety into the RL policy and examine how such a system behaves during filter-free deployment. However, the filter that keeps training safe also hides what the policy must learn: it masks the cost of unsafe actions, which actor-critic methods then overvalue, and it keeps near-collision states out of the training data. Our approach therefore learns only from executed safe actions with implicit Q-learning and distills the filter into the policy at synthetic near-collision states. We prove that filter distillation loss bounds the policy's constraint violation and hence how far agents can cross their safety margin, so errors never accumulate. When distillation states cover deployed states, the loss also bounds the collision probability at every step. Without a filter and acting only on local observations, our policies have no collisions in 1,800 test episodes with multiple agents. A policy trained with three agents transfers zero-shot to teams of twenty at constant per-agent computation and stays collision-free with up to eight agents. We test our policies on Crazyflie quadrotors with up to five flying at the same time.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）可以教会机器人团队在共享空间中导航，但试错会导致碰撞，而真实机器人无法承受这些碰撞。控制屏障函数（CBF）安全滤波器通过纠正不安全动作来防止这些碰撞，但在团队中，滤波器变成集中式优化，其约束数量随团队规模二次增长。我们提出一种将滤波器安全性内建到RL策略中的方法，并考察此类系统在无滤波器部署期间的行为。然而，保持训练安全的滤波器也隐藏了策略必须学习的内容：它掩盖不安全动作的代价，actor-critic方法因此会高估这些代价，并且它将接近碰撞的状态排除在训练数据之外。因此，我们的方法仅通过隐式Q学习从已执行的安全动作中学习，并在合成的近碰撞状态下将滤波器蒸馏到策略中。我们证明，滤波器蒸馏损失界定了策略的约束违反程度，从而界定了智能体能够越过其安全裕度的距离，因此误差不会累积。当蒸馏状态覆盖部署状态时，该损失还界定了每一步的碰撞概率。在没有滤波器且仅基于局部观测行动的情况下，我们的策略在包含多个智能体的1,800个测试回合中无碰撞。用三个智能体训练的策略在每智能体计算量恒定的情况下零样本迁移到二十个智能体的团队，并在最多八个智能体时保持无碰撞。我们在Crazyflie四旋翼上测试策略，最多五架同时飞行。
items.comment: 23 pages, 4 figures and 6 tables

rm.usage: 把 CBF 安全过滤蒸馏进策略、仅靠局部观测实现多智能体无碰撞飞行的方案，可用于 4 架空中机器人同时在狭小机库/场地内的相互避让与起降排队，且不依赖机间无线组网；但需自建带动力学约束的仿真并完成实机验证，属于需要改造的训练型方案。

items.title_en: Technical Report of Auriga's 1:10 Scale Autonomous Vehicle Robot
items.title_zh: Auriga 1:10比例自动驾驶车辆机器人的技术报告
items.abstract_en: This report presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' 1:10 scale autonomous vehicle, developed at Shahid Beheshti University's Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory. The platform integrates a custom mechanical chassis, a distributed embedded system based on ESP32 microcontrollers, and a Jetson Orin NX module for high-level perception and control. The embedded layer manages sensor interfacing, real-time data acquisition, and actuator control, while the Jetson handles environment perception through deep-learning--based lane, sign, and traffic light detection, as well as decision-making and trajectory control. System communication is achieved via structured UART links, ensuring synchronized operation between perception and control subsystems. The vehicle's software stack incorporates ROS, modular firmware design, and multiple control algorithms---Stanley, PID, and Pure Pursuit---to achieve stable autonomous navigation in structured driving scenarios. The overall system demonstrates robust performance and reliability in urban-like environments, serving as a modular research platform for future autonomous driving studies.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告介绍Auriga Robotics的1:10比例自动驾驶车辆的设计与实现，该车辆在Shahid Beheshti大学机器人与智能自动化实验室开发。该平台集成定制机械底盘、基于ESP32微控制器的分布式嵌入式系统，以及用于高层感知与控制的Jetson Orin NX模块。嵌入式层管理传感器接口、实时数据采集和执行器控制，而Jetson通过基于深度学习的车道、标志和交通灯检测处理环境感知，以及决策和轨迹控制。系统通信通过结构化UART链路实现，确保感知与控制子系统之间的同步运行。车辆软件栈包含ROS、模块化固件设计以及多种控制算法——Stanley、PID和Pure Pursuit——以在结构化驾驶场景中实现稳定的自主导航。整体系统在类城市环境中表现出稳健的性能和可靠性，可作为未来自动驾驶研究的模块化研究平台。
items.comment: 62 pages, 32 figures, 11 tables, 1 algorithm. Technical report of Team Auriga's 2025 1:10 scale autonomous vehicle platform (Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Shahid Beheshti University)

items.title_en: Prediction-Error-Tightened MPC for Socially Compliant Crowd Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向社会合规人群导航的预测误差收紧MPC
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation of mobile robots in crowded environments, while preserving pedestrians' psychological comfort, requires distinguishing pedestrians from other obstacles, predicting their future motion, and accounting for uncertainty in the predicted trajectories of both pedestrians and the robot. This work extends a previous MPC framework by integrating obstacle and pedestrian detection, Koopman-based motion prediction, and online prediction-error estimation directly within the collision-avoidance mechanism. To reduce collision-avoidance complexity in crowded scenarios, nearby obstacles are aggregated, thereby reducing the number of collision-avoidance constraints. Simulation studies evaluate the prediction-error margins and the computational benefits of semantics-aware aggregation. In a paired 300-seed closed-loop comparison with a moving generic obstacle, Markov residual tightening reduces the fraction of runs with physical contact from $10.0\%$ to $1.33\%$, at a mean travel-time cost of $0.68$ s. In a separate crowd-navigation semantic ablation, the offline robot-footprint/personal-space overlap occupies $2.11\%$ of observed time with pedestrian-aware handling versus $22.84\%$ with generic-obstacle handling.
items.abstract_zh: 在拥挤环境中，移动机器人的自主导航同时需要保持行人的心理舒适性，这要求区分行人与其他障碍物、预测其未来运动，并考虑行人和机器人预测轨迹中的不确定性。本工作扩展了先前的MPC框架，将障碍物与行人检测、基于Koopman的运动预测以及在线预测误差估计直接集成到避碰机制中。为降低拥挤场景下的避碰复杂度，对邻近障碍物进行聚合，从而减少避碰约束的数量。仿真研究评估了预测误差裕度以及语义感知聚合的计算收益。在与移动的通用障碍物进行的配对300种子闭环比较中，Markov残差收紧将发生物理接触的运行比例从10.0%降低到1.33%，平均旅行时间代价为0.68 s。在单独的群体导航语义消融中，采用行人感知处理时，离线机器人足迹/个人空间重叠占观测时间的2.11%，而采用通用障碍物处理时为22.84%。
items.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to the European Control Conference (ECC 2027)

rm.usage: 把障碍聚合与预测误差收紧的安全裕度思路，移植到哨兵在敌方机器人频繁穿插时的 MPC 避障上，可在算力受限下减少碰撞约束数量；人群社交舒适度建模与行人语义对赛场不适用，需替换为机器人运动预测。

items.title_en: MiniPose: Miniature-Based Real Data Collection for 6D Pose Estimation of Large Industrial Pipe Segments
items.title_zh: MiniPose：用于大型工业管段6D位姿估计的基于缩比模型的真实数据采集
items.abstract_en: 6-DOF pose estimation of large and heavy industrial objects, such as large piping systems in shipyards and structural components in petrochemical plants, remains relatively underexplored in robotic perception. Repeatedly repositioning large objects is physically and spatially demanding, making it difficult to acquire real training data with sufficient pose diversity. Synthetic data offer a scalable alternative, but faithfully reproducing real RGB-D observations, particularly the structured measurement errors of real depth sensors, remains difficult. We propose MiniPose, a practical pipeline for miniature-based real RGB-D data collection that addresses both the data-acquisition burden and the sim-to-real gap. We fabricate a scaled-down replica and capture RGB-D data of it in diverse poses using a real RGB-D camera. RGB images are used directly, while depth maps are converted to a geometrically consistent representation of the full-scale object via a simple inverse scaling transformation. This allows training to incorporate real appearance and sensor measurement characteristics that are difficult to reproduce using synthetic data alone. To examine whether the benefit depends on a particular network, we evaluate two RGB-D pose estimators with different formulations, PVN3D and RDPN6D. Mixing at most 1,000 miniature images per pipe type, less than 10\% of the training data, with 10,000 synthetic images improves the mean ADD-S AUC across pipe types over synthetic-only training for both estimators. A comparison with training on full-scale real data further suggests that miniature data can serve as a proxy where full-scale collection is difficult, reducing the data-collection burden for large industrial objects.
items.abstract_zh: 大型重型工业物体（如船厂中的大型管道系统和石化工厂中的结构部件）的6自由度位姿估计在机器人感知中仍相对研究不足。反复重新摆放大尺寸物体在物理和空间上都要求很高，导致难以获取具有足够位姿多样性的真实训练数据。合成数据提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但忠实再现真实RGB-D观测——尤其是真实深度传感器的结构化测量误差——仍然困难。我们提出MiniPose，一种基于缩比模型的真实RGB-D数据采集实用流程，同时解决数据采集负担和仿真到现实差距。我们制作一个按比例缩小的复制品，并使用真实RGB-D相机捕获其在多种位姿下的RGB-D数据。RGB图像直接使用，而深度图通过简单的逆缩放变换转换为全尺寸物体的几何一致表示。这使训练能够纳入仅靠合成数据难以再现的真实外观和传感器测量特性。为检验该收益是否依赖于特定网络，我们评估了两种具有不同形式的RGB-D位姿估计器PVN3D和RDPN6D。每种管型最多混合1,000张缩比模型图像（不足训练数据的10%）与10,000张合成图像，可在两种估计器上提高跨管型的平均ADD-S AUC，优于仅使用合成数据的训练。与在全尺寸真实数据上训练的比较进一步表明，在全尺寸数据采集困难时，缩比模型数据可作为替代，从而减轻大型工业物体的数据采集负担。
items.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

items.title_en: DeRep: Learning Depth Representations for End-to-End Navigation in Cluttered Environments
items.title_zh: DeRep：面向杂乱环境中端到端导航的深度表示学习
items.abstract_en: End-to-end navigation in cluttered environments relies on compact visual representations to support collision avoidance and goal-directed motion. Existing methods typically learn these representations jointly with the policy or through observation reconstruction, which does not explicitly specify what information the representation should preserve. Moreover, they are usually evaluated with a single downstream policy learner, although the benefit of a representation may depend on how the policy is learned. It therefore remains unclear how different representation-learning objectives affect downstream navigation performance and robustness. This work proposes DeRep, a navigation-oriented representation-learning method that combines local bird's-eye-view reachability supervision with depth reconstruction. To compare representation objectives under controlled conditions, we pretrain encoders with a common architecture and freeze them during downstream learning. We evaluate the representations using a linear policy probe, flow-matching imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with PPO. DeRep achieves the lowest linear policy probe prediction error and outperforms reconstruction alone across all six tested PPO conditions. In imitation learning, both reachability-based objectives achieve higher mean success rates than reconstruction alone, with similar mean success rates between the reachability-only and joint objectives. These results demonstrate consistent benefits of incorporating reachability supervision into depth representation pretraining across different downstream learning methods and evaluation conditions. We further deploy the PPO policy with the frozen DeRep encoder in Gazebo and on a physical quadrotor without fine-tuning, demonstrating its capability for zero-shot sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer.
items.abstract_zh: 杂乱环境中的端到端导航依赖于紧凑的视觉表示来支持避碰和目标导向运动。现有方法通常将这些表示与策略联合学习，或通过观测重建来学习，这并未明确指定表示应保留哪些信息。此外，它们通常仅用单一的下游策略学习器进行评估，尽管表示带来的收益可能取决于策略的学习方式。因此，不同表示学习目标如何影响下游导航性能和鲁棒性仍不清楚。本文提出 DeRep，一种面向导航的表示学习方法，将局部鸟瞰图可达性监督与深度重建相结合。为在受控条件下比较表示目标，我们使用相同架构预训练编码器，并在下游学习期间将其冻结。我们使用线性策略探针、流匹配模仿学习和 PPO 强化学习来评估这些表示。DeRep 取得最低的线性策略探针预测误差，并在所有六种测试的 PPO 条件下优于仅重建方法。在模仿学习中，两种基于可达性的目标均比仅重建取得更高的平均成功率，而仅可达性目标与联合目标的平均成功率相近。这些结果表明，在不同下游学习方法和评估条件下，将可达性监督纳入深度表示预训练具有一致的收益。我们进一步将带有冻结 DeRep 编码器的 PPO 策略部署到 Gazebo 和实体四旋翼上，无需微调，展示了其零样本 sim-to-sim 和 sim-to-real 迁移能力。
items.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures

items.title_en: A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots
items.title_zh: 面向野外机器人的紧耦合磁-惯性SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 在矿井、隧道和灾区作业的野外机器人，需要在GNSS拒止以及由粉尘、烟雾或光照不良导致的相机和LiDAR测量退化条件下仍具备可靠定位。同时涉及地面和空中机器人的任务进一步促使采用不依赖可见性、预装基础设施或车轮接触的互补传感模态。本文提出MISLAM，一种紧耦合磁-惯性同时定位与建图系统，使用IMU和九磁强计阵列，不依赖外部里程计或平台特定运动假设。该系统将惯性导航模型与用于短期运动估计的局部多项式磁场模型相结合，并使用误差状态卡尔曼滤波器结合全局高斯过程模型进行漂移校正。在三个使用手持装置采集的室内数据集上进行离线评估，结果显示总端点闭合误差相对于磁-惯性里程计降低45.7%–78.0%。在光照不良条件下，MISLAM在视觉-惯性里程计失效后仍保持跟踪，达到0.332 m的水平闭合误差，但垂直漂移仍是一个限制。这些结果支持将磁-惯性SLAM作为在视觉条件退化下运行的机器人传感器套件的补充定位模态。

items.title_en: ECO-COMM: An Ultra Low-Latency Event Camera based Optical Communication System
items.title_zh: ECO-COMM：一种基于事件相机的超低时延光通信系统
items.abstract_en: Ultralow-latency communication is critical for emerging next-generation applications such as XR, real-time control, and distributed sensing. We present ECO-COMM, an event-camera-based optical communication system for ultra-low-latency device association and lightweight information exchange. By exploiting the asynchronous sensing and microsecond-level temporal resolution of event cameras, ECO-COMM captures high-frequency optical signals without frame-based acquisition delays. We identify and analyze key hardware-induced challenges in event-camera communication, including timestamp inconsistency, readout contention, trailing effects, and the inevitable refractory period, and develop hardware-aware mitigation techniques to address them. Focusing on a single transmitter-receiver optical link, ECO-COMM establishes the feasibility of practical ultra-low-latency event-camera communication using commercially available hardware.A prototype implementation using an eight-LED transmitter and an off-the-shelf event camera achieves device association within 15 microseconds, symbol latency as low as 100 microseconds, and end-to-end latency below 8 milliseconds for 32-byte payloads at 0.1% bit error rate. ECO-COMM establishes a practical and complementary communication paradigm for ultra-low-latency systems where responsiveness and temporal precision are paramount.
items.abstract_zh: 超低时延通信对XR、实时控制和分布式感知等新兴下一代应用至关重要。我们提出ECO-COMM，一种基于事件相机的光通信系统，用于超低时延的设备关联与轻量信息交换。利用事件相机的异步感知与微秒级时间分辨率，ECO-COMM无需基于帧的采集延迟即可捕获高频光信号。我们识别并分析了事件相机通信中若干关键的硬件诱发挑战，包括时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应以及不可避免的不应期，并开发了硬件感知的缓解技术予以应对。聚焦单个发射机—接收机光链路，ECO-COMM验证了使用商用现成硬件实现实用超低时延事件相机通信的可行性。基于八个LED发射机与商用事件相机的原型实现，可在15微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至100微秒，并在0.1%误码率下实现32字节载荷低于8毫秒的端到端时延。ECO-COMM为以响应性和时间精度为优先的超低时延系统建立了一种实用且互补的通信范式。
items.highlight_zh: 用事件相机实现15微秒设备关联的超低时延光通信
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：XR、实时控制、分布式感知等应用对通信时延极其敏感，传统相机以固定帧率采集，天然带来帧周期等待，难以支撑微秒级的设备发现与轻量数据交换。

方法思路：作者提出 ECO-COMM，改用事件相机作为光接收端。事件相机不是逐帧曝光，而是每个像素在亮度变化时异步输出事件，因此具备微秒级时间分辨率，能直接捕捉高速闪烁的光信号，避免帧采集延迟。团队还系统梳理了这类方案中由硬件引入的四类难题：时间戳不一致、读出竞争、拖尾效应与不应期，并针对性地设计了硬件感知的补偿与调度技术。

实验结果：在单发射机—单接收机的链路原型上，使用八个 LED 组成的发射端与商用事件相机，系统可在 15 微秒内完成设备关联，符号时延低至 100 微秒；传输 32 字节载荷时，在 0.1% 误码率下端到端时延低于 8 毫秒。

为何重要：该工作证明仅用市面可得的硬件就能实现实用的超低时延光通信，并给出了一条与射频方案互补的技术路线。其价值在于把“感知式接收”引入通信领域，为对响应速度与时间精度要求极高的系统提供了新的设计范式，同时也为后续多链路、更高吞吐的研究标出了硬件瓶颈。

items.title_en: Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation
items.title_zh: 按指令飞行：面向无人机视觉语言导航的世界-动作策略精炼
items.abstract_en: Natural language-guided UAV navigation enables intuitive human-robot interaction and flexible autonomous flight in complex environments. However, reliable navigation requires accurate instruction following, continuous task progress tracking, and safe obstacle avoidance, which remain challenging for existing world-action models that primarily focus on action prediction. To address these limitations, we propose a world-action learning framework that integrates three complementary mechanisms: a language-conditioned action interface with targeted post-training for instruction-responsive motion, recurrent instruction-consumption prediction to track task progress and determine termination, and Gaussian-scene post-training to enhance obstacle avoidance through trajectory imitation and differentiable geometric feedback. Closed-loop evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate improvements in sequential task completion, safe goal reaching, and timely termination. Furthermore, direct one-step denoising reduces inference overhead, and real-world indoor and outdoor flights validate the framework's effectiveness.
items.abstract_zh: 自然语言引导的无人机导航能够实现直观的人机交互，并在复杂环境中实现灵活的自主飞行。然而，可靠导航需要准确遵循指令、持续跟踪任务进度并安全避障，这对主要关注动作预测的现有世界-动作模型仍然具有挑战性。为解决这些局限，我们提出一个世界-动作学习框架，集成三种互补机制：带有针对性后训练的语言条件动作接口，用于产生指令响应式运动；循环指令消耗预测，用于跟踪任务进度并确定终止；以及高斯场景后训练，通过轨迹模仿和可微几何反馈增强避障能力。闭环评估与消融研究表明，在顺序任务完成、安全到达目标以及及时终止方面均有改进。此外，直接一步去噪降低了推理开销，真实世界的室内和室外飞行验证了该框架的有效性。

items.title_en: SPARC: RoboCup Standard Platform for Autonomous Rescue Competition with Initial Datasets, Software, and Simulation Environments
items.title_zh: SPARC：面向自主救援竞赛的RoboCup标准平台，包含初始数据集、软件与仿真环境
items.abstract_en: The RoboCup Standard Platform for Autonomous Rescue Competition (SPARC) is a new competition under development of the RoboCup Rescue Robot League that uses the Unitree A2-W as a common robot platform. SPARC aims to make research on artificial intelligence for autonomous rescue robots accessible to a broader research community, including groups without expertise in developing and maintaining custom robot hardware. By providing a capable standard platform and established benchmark environments, researchers can focus on autonomous navigation, perception, manipulation, and embodied AI for challenging disaster-response scenarios. This paper introduces the SPARC competition, its benchmark environment, and the Unitree A2-W standard platform. Furthermore, we present the first open SPARC datasets collected during the IEEE ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges and RoboCup Rescue 2026, release an open-source software stack for autonomous navigation, and provide initial simulation assets representing RoboCup Rescue test environments. Together, these resources aim to lower the barrier to entry for autonomous rescue robotics and facilitate reproducible research and collaborative development on a common hardware platform.
items.abstract_zh: RoboCup自主救援竞赛标准平台（SPARC）是RoboCup救援机器人联赛正在开发的一项新竞赛，使用Unitree A2-W作为通用机器人平台。SPARC旨在使自主救援机器人的人工智能研究能够为更广泛的研究社区所使用，包括那些不具备开发和维护定制机器人硬件专长的团队。通过提供能力强的标准平台和已建立的基准环境，研究人员可以专注于面向具有挑战性的灾难响应场景的自主导航、感知、操作和具身AI。本文介绍SPARC竞赛、其基准环境以及Unitree A2-W标准平台。此外，我们展示了在IEEE ICRA 2026腿足机器人挑战赛和RoboCup Rescue 2026期间收集的首批开放SPARC数据集，发布了用于自主导航的开源软件栈，并提供了代表RoboCup Rescue测试环境的初始仿真资产。这些资源共同旨在降低自主救援机器人技术的入门门槛，并促进在通用硬件平台上的可复现研究和协作开发。
