items.title_en: Passage-Focused Soft Coordination for Hierarchical Multi-Robot Navigation in Bottleneck Environments
items.title_zh: 面向瓶颈环境分层多机器人导航的通道聚焦软协调
items.abstract_en: In multi-robot navigation, rigid global schedules are sensitive to execution deviations, while local methods lack long-horizon coordination. We propose a passage-focused framework combining soft global coordination with flexible local execution. A passage-induced graph of convex sets supports priority-ordered planning with two levels of soft coordination. Passage-aware route selection accounts for passage usage and traversal directions, while route-restricted continuous space-time planning penalizes temporal conflicts. The resulting references guide a model predictive path integral controller that avoids collisions online. Adaptive temporal and geometric tracking accommodates execution deviations, while selective replanning maintains coordination without rigid trajectory reservations. Across 1,200 instances in 4 different environments with 5-30 robots, the framework achieves a near-perfect success rate and outperforms evaluated baselines in makespan and flowtime. Hardware experiments with 8 robots demonstrate successful completion of all trials without collisions. These results highlight the effectiveness of passage-focused coordination in balancing long-horizon cooperation with flexible execution.
items.abstract_zh: 在多机器人导航中，刚性的全局调度对执行偏差敏感，而局部方法缺乏长时程协调。我们提出一种通道聚焦框架，将软全局协调与灵活的局部执行相结合。由通道诱导的凸集图支持具有两级软协调的优先级排序规划。通道感知的路径选择考虑通道使用和通行方向，而路线受限的连续时空规划对时间冲突施加惩罚。生成的参考轨迹引导模型预测路径积分控制器在线避碰。自适应时间与几何跟踪适应执行偏差，而选择性重规划在没有刚性轨迹预留的情况下维持协调。在4个不同环境、5–30个机器人的1,200个实例中，该框架达到接近完美的成功率，并在完工时间和流时间上优于所评估的基线。8个机器人的硬件实验表明所有试验均成功完成且无碰撞。这些结果凸显了通道聚焦协调在平衡长时程合作与灵活执行方面的有效性。
items.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters

rm.usage: 其“通道”抽象可映射到 RMUC 场地的狭窄通道（如高地通道、环形高地入口），把长时程通行优先级与局部 MPC/避障结合，用于哨兵在通道处与其他己方机器人错峰通行；但该文是多机连续空间协调，哨兵单机自主决策需大幅简化改造。

items.title_en: Rendering-Free Event Frame Simulation for Fast Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向自主机器人导航快速强化学习的无渲染事件帧仿真
items.abstract_en: Event cameras offer low latency, high dynamic range, and milliwatt-level power consumption, making them ideal for agile robots such as tiny drones navigating through cluttered environments. However, existing simulators generally render photorealistic images before converting them into events, making large-scale reinforcement learning prohibitively slow. We propose an analytic event simulator that exploits what event cameras fundamentally measure - moving contrast edges - to synthesize event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion without visual rendering. Our simulator generates a 64x64 event observation in 17 microseconds on a single GPU - over 400x faster than a state-of-the-art rendering pipeline - enabling end-to-end reinforcement learning for goal-directed obstacle avoidance to converge in under 30 minutes - three orders of magnitude faster than training on rendered events. Policies transfer zero-shot to physically based event simulations (ray-traced Isaac Sim). Our policy reaches 83% success in cluttered courses unseen during training (mid-difficulty, traversability probability approx. 0.57), at 2.4 m/s average goal velocity, and retains 70% in a simulated texture-dense indoor hall. Furthermore, we quantized the policy to a 1.2 MB int8 network running fully onboard a 56-gram Crazyflie equipped with a Prophesee GenX320 event camera and an OpenMV N6 microcontroller board. Without any fine-tuning, external processing, or positioning, the policy achieves an average success rate of 82% (5/5, 5/6, 4/6 flights) across three real-world obstacle courses of increasing difficulty. Code: https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机具有低延迟、高动态范围和毫瓦级功耗，使其非常适合敏捷机器人，例如在杂乱环境中导航的微型无人机。然而，现有仿真器通常先渲染照片级真实图像，再将其转换为事件，这使得大规模强化学习慢得难以承受。我们提出一种解析事件仿真器，利用事件相机从根本上测量的内容——运动对比度边缘——直接从场景几何和自运动合成事件流，而无需视觉渲染。我们的仿真器在单块 GPU 上于 17 微秒内生成 64x64 事件观测，比最先进的渲染流水线快 400 倍以上，使目标导向避障的端到端强化学习能在 30 分钟内收敛，比在渲染事件上训练快三个数量级。策略可零样本迁移到基于物理的事件仿真（光线追踪 Isaac Sim）。我们的策略在训练中未见过的杂乱赛道（中等难度，可通行概率约 0.57）中达到 83% 的成功率，平均目标速度为 2.4 m/s，并在模拟的纹理密集室内大厅中保持 70% 的成功率。此外，我们将策略量化为 1.2 MB 的 int8 网络，完全在搭载 Prophesee GenX320 事件相机和 OpenMV N6 微控制器板的 56 克 Crazyflie 上机载运行。无需任何微调、外部处理或定位，该策略在三条难度递增的真实障碍赛道中平均成功率达到 82%（5/5、5/6、4/6 次飞行）。代码：https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav
authors: Guido C. H. E. de Croon

rm.usage: 其用解析式事件仿真替代渲染来加速强化学习避障训练、并量化到机载小网络的流程，可作 sim 任务的训练加速思路参考；但事件相机与 RM 空中机器人常用感知/通信相机差异大，且策略依赖特定平台，不能直接移植为参赛避障方案。

items.title_en: Real-Time Disturbance-Aware Koopman Model Predictive Control for Quadrotors in Spatially Varying Winds
items.title_zh: 空间变化风场中四旋翼的实时扰动感知Koopman模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Reliable quadrotor flight in disturbed environments requires predictive models that remain accurate as unmodeled aerodynamic effects change during deployment. We introduce a disturbance-aware Koopman Control Family (DA-KCF) framework that preserves an offline-identified nominal model while learning only a disturbance-induced correction online. A reference-dependent KCF is first learned from simulation data and calibrated using limited hardware data. During deployment, the nominal KCF remains fixed while a lightweight residual ensemble learns a low-dimensional disturbance correction from causal state-command-state transitions. The Adaptive DA-KCF model is incorporated into MPC, where disturbance corrections are evaluated along the prediction horizon to optimize position and yaw references sent to the onboard stabilizing controller. Hardware experiments on a nano-quadrotor under uniform wind and a spatially varying wake demonstrate that online adaptation improves multi-step prediction and trajectory tracking as disturbance-induced model mismatch increases, while satisfying real-time control requirements.
items.abstract_zh: 在受扰环境中实现可靠的四旋翼飞行，需要预测模型在部署过程中未建模气动效应发生变化时仍保持准确。我们提出扰动感知Koopman控制族（DA-KCF）框架，该框架保留离线辨识的标称模型，仅在线学习由扰动引起的修正。首先从仿真数据中学习依赖参考的KCF，并使用有限的硬件数据进行校准。在部署期间，标称KCF保持固定，而轻量级残差集成从因果的状态-指令-状态转移中学习低维扰动修正。将自适应DA-KCF模型纳入MPC，在预测时域上评估扰动修正，以优化发送给机载稳定控制器的位置和偏航参考。在均匀风和空间变化尾流下对纳米四旋翼进行的硬件实验表明，随着扰动引起的模型失配增大，在线自适应改善了多步预测和轨迹跟踪，同时满足实时控制要求。

items.title_en: Polygraph: Large-Scale Multi-Session Trajectory Optimization using Pose Graphs
items.title_zh: Polygraph：使用位姿图的大规模多会话轨迹优化
items.abstract_en: Robots, vehicles, and wearable devices often traverse the same environment many times. Each pass produces its own trajectory from onboard visual or visual-inertial odometry. These trajectories are locally accurate but drift over time and live in unrelated coordinate frames. Turning many such independent trajectories into one globally consistent set is the large-scale multi-session trajectory optimization problem. Existing solutions largely work offline. All sessions must be available up front, one session is fixed as the reference frame, and a single fused map is then optimized. This paper presents Polygraph, a multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline that processes sessions online, one keyframe and one spatial cluster at a time, and never builds a 3D map. Keyframes are grouped into local clusters. When a cluster closes, it is matched against every other session through learned image retrieval. Candidate pairs are verified with sparse feature matching, monocular metric depth, and robust pose estimation. A two-tier consensus gate admits a cross-session edge into the shared pose graph only once independent evidence corroborates it. A cheap incremental solve keeps the graph current, and a periodic robust batch solve prunes outliers. We evaluate Polygraph on stereo outdoor driving, HoloLens and iPad indoor traversals, legged indoor locomotion with a Boston Dynamics Spot, and large-scale outdoor vehicle and handheld routes. Against the closest prior work on the same GPU model, using its reported timings, Polygraph runs faster, commits fewer loop-closure edges, and matches or improves on accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人、车辆和可穿戴设备经常多次穿越同一环境。每次通行都会根据机载视觉或视觉惯性里程计生成各自的轨迹。这些轨迹在局部是准确的，但会随时间漂移，且处于互不相关的坐标系中。将许多此类独立轨迹转换为一个全局一致的集合，就是大规模多会话轨迹优化问题。现有解决方案大多离线运行。所有会话必须事先可用，一个会话被固定为参考坐标系，然后优化单个融合地图。本文提出 Polygraph，一种多会话轨迹优化流水线，它以在线方式处理会话，每次处理一个关键帧和一个空间簇，并且从不构建 3D 地图。关键帧被分组为局部簇。当一个簇闭合时，通过学习式图像检索将其与每个其他会话进行匹配。候选对通过稀疏特征匹配、单目度量深度和鲁棒位姿估计进行验证。两级一致性门控仅在独立证据证实后，才允许跨会话边进入共享位姿图。廉价的增量求解保持图的最新状态，定期的鲁棒批求解剔除离群值。我们在立体室外驾驶、HoloLens 和 iPad 室内穿越、使用 Boston Dynamics Spot 的腿式室内运动，以及大规模室外车辆和手持路线上评估 Polygraph。在同一 GPU 型号上，与最接近的先前工作相比，使用其报告的运行时间，Polygraph 运行更快，提交的闭环边更少，并在精度上达到或超过其水平。

rm.usage: 多会话位姿图在线融合与回环，RM 场地地图固定且单场次运行，跨会话地图合并需求很弱，最多在长期调试时合并多次建图结果。

items.title_en: Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向机器人导航的模糊可解释持续分层强化学习
items.abstract_en: Continual robot navigation requires reinforcement learning policies to continuously adapt to new environments while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Meanwhile, explainable reinforcement learning aims to learn meaningful behavioral representations through policy interaction. However, these objectives are inherently conflicting, as continual learning emphasizes policy stability whereas explainable behavior learning requires adaptive exploration. Existing methods rarely address both simultaneously. To resolve this issue, this paper proposes a Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (FECHRL) method. A two-stage behavior cloning strategy is introduced to balance rapid policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution by progressively transitioning from strong imitation guidance to autonomous reinforcement learning. Furthermore, a fuzzy critic based on a Takagi--Sugeno fuzzy inference system is proposed to alleviate value extrapolation errors during the transition between imitation-guided learning and autonomous exploration, thereby improving continual training stability. Experimental results on sequential multi-scenario navigation tasks demonstrate that the proposed method effectively unifies continual learning capability and policy explainability within a single reinforcement learning framework, achieving stable knowledge retention and meaningful behavioral explanation.
items.abstract_zh: 持续机器人导航要求强化学习策略在保留已获取知识的同时持续适应新环境。与此同时，可解释强化学习旨在通过策略交互学习有意义的行为表示。然而，这些目标本质上相互冲突，因为持续学习强调策略稳定性，而可解释行为学习需要自适应探索。现有方法很少同时解决二者。为解决该问题，本文提出一种模糊可解释持续分层强化学习（FECHRL）方法。引入两阶段行为克隆策略，通过从强模仿引导逐步过渡到自主强化学习，平衡快速策略适应与可解释行为演化。此外，提出一种基于 Takagi–Sugeno 模糊推理系统的模糊评论家，以缓解模仿引导学习与自主探索之间过渡期间的价值外推误差，从而提高持续训练稳定性。在序列多场景导航任务上的实验结果表明，所提方法在单一强化学习框架内有效统一了持续学习能力和策略可解释性，实现了稳定的知识保留和有意义的行为解释。

rm.usage: 持续学习+分层强化学习的导航策略，可用于在仿真中训练哨兵在多场景间切换的导航策略并保留旧知识，但缺少 RM 场地奖励与实机验证，需自建环境和安全兜底。

items.title_en: JEPTERA: A Platform Agnostic JEPA-Assisted Model Predictive Planner for Urban UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: JEPTERA：一种用于城市无人机导航的平台无关JEPA辅助模型预测规划器
items.abstract_en: Urban navigation for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) requires planning that accounts for environmental geometry, vehicle dynamics, and moving obstacles. This paper presents JEPTERA, a navigation architecture that integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), Model Predictive Control (MPC), PID control, and a safety layer. JEPA predicts the UAV's motion response to candidate commands for MPC action selection, while the safety layer checks trajectories against occupied space and predicted obstacle motion. Simulator adapters and platform-specific YAML configurations separate the planning core from simulator interfaces. An ablation study evaluated six configurations across three gym scenarios, totaling 180 runs. The complete architecture achieved the highest aggregate success rate, completing 28 of 30 runs. Additional tests completed one route across three city maps without collisions. Separate integration tests demonstrated operation in Gazebo/ROS 2, MuJoCo, and CARLA without modifying the core planning logic. These results support the feasibility of the integrated architecture for simulated urban UAV navigation and its portability across simulator interfaces.
items.abstract_zh: 城市环境中的无人机（UAV）导航需要规划能够考虑环境几何、车辆动力学和移动障碍物。本文提出JEPTERA，一种集成了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）、模型预测控制（MPC）、PID控制和安全层的导航架构。JEPA预测无人机对候选指令的运动响应，以供MPC选择动作，而安全层则根据占据空间和预测的障碍物运动检查轨迹。仿真器适配器和平台特定的YAML配置将规划核心与仿真器接口分离。消融研究在三个gym场景中评估了六种配置，总计180次运行。完整架构取得了最高的总体成功率，在30次运行中完成了28次。额外测试在三个城市地图上完成了一条路线且无碰撞。单独的集成测试表明，无需修改核心规划逻辑即可在Gazebo/ROS 2、MuJoCo和CARLA中运行。这些结果支持该集成架构用于仿真城市无人机导航的可行性及其跨仿真器接口的可移植性。
items.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to conference

items.title_en: Elastra: A Simulation Framework for Elastic Bodies
items.title_zh: Elastra：一种弹性体仿真框架
items.abstract_en: When robots interact with elastic surfaces such as mattresses and trampolines, changes in loading cause the surfaces to deform and rebound, altering subsequent contact locations and forces. We present Elastra, a simulation framework for modeling this interaction and supporting the training and evaluation of robot control policies. Elastra represents each surface using elements that move only vertically, with elastic connections and damping to model deformation and recovery. Contact forces drive surface motion, and the updated surface geometry is used to compute subsequent contact forces. We systematically validate our simulations against an independent implementation and a real mattress load curve. We further use Elastra to train the Unitree G1 humanoid to stand up on mattresses and trampolines. Using the pretrained HoST policy and ProtoMotions motion tracker as original controllers, we train residual policies through reinforcement learning to add corrections to their joint targets. Adding these residual policies increases the success rate with HoST from 44.1\% to 72.5\%, and from 55\% to 89\% on the trampoline. With ProtoMotions, the success rate increases from 19.0\% to 45.0\% for initial poses not encountered during training. The code and video are available on https://github.com/yichg/elastra.
items.abstract_zh: 当机器人与床垫、蹦床等弹性表面交互时，载荷变化会导致表面变形和回弹，从而改变后续的接触位置和力。我们提出Elastra，一个用于建模这种交互并支持机器人控制策略训练与评估的仿真框架。Elastra使用仅沿垂直方向运动的单元表示每个表面，并通过弹性连接和阻尼来建模变形与恢复。接触力驱动表面运动，更新后的表面几何用于计算后续接触力。我们通过独立实现和真实床垫载荷曲线系统地验证了仿真。我们进一步使用Elastra训练Unitree G1人形机器人在床垫和蹦床上站立。以预训练的HoST策略和ProtoMotions运动跟踪器作为原始控制器，我们通过强化学习训练残差策略，为其关节目标添加修正。加入这些残差策略后，HoST的成功率从44.1%提高到72.5%，在蹦床上从55%提高到89%。对于训练中未遇到的初始姿态，使用ProtoMotions时成功率从19.0%提高到45.0%。代码和视频见 https://github.com/yichg/elastra。

items.title_en: WRAP: Fixtureless Wrench-aware Multi-Robot Assembly Planning
items.title_zh: WRAP：无夹具的力旋量感知多机器人装配规划
items.abstract_en: Assembly using robots often requires specially designed fixtures, or relies on top-down only assembly strategies. Using multiple robots, we can avoid using fixtures and make robotic assembly more flexible. Planning assembly sequences for multiple robots is challenging due to the high number of possible task assignments and orders. In addition, we need to reason over forces that occur during the assembly process, e.g., to decide if multiple robots are required for support, or if external support such as a table should be used. We present Wrap, a multi-robot assembly planner for multi-part assemblies, given the inter-part ordering-dependencies, the part meshes, and their initial state. We formulate a linear program to reason about valid grasps for supporting the forces that occur during assembly. The search leverages the assembly sequence, and greedily finds a feasible solution per assembly step by computing a heuristic via a cheap backwards search, and using the heuristic in the more expensive forward search. We then solve the multi-robot, multi-goal motion planning problem, and for execution, we split the plan into contact-rich assembly skills, and free space motion. We benchmark the planner on a variety of multi-part assemblies, and apply the planner to groups of robots differing in size and kinematics. We validate the work both in a physics simulation, and in real. Videos and code are available at https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人装配通常需要专门设计的夹具，或依赖仅自上而下的装配策略。使用多个机器人可以避免使用夹具，并使机器人装配更加灵活。由于可能的任务分配和顺序数量众多，为多个机器人规划装配序列具有挑战性。此外，还需要对装配过程中产生的力进行推理，例如判断是否需要多个机器人提供支撑，或是否应使用桌子等外部支撑。我们提出Wrap，一种面向多零件装配的多机器人装配规划器，输入为零件间顺序依赖关系、零件网格及其初始状态。我们构建线性规划来推理用于支撑装配过程中所产生力的有效抓取。搜索利用装配序列，并通过廉价的后向搜索计算启发式，在每个装配步骤中贪婪地寻找可行解，再将启发式用于更昂贵的前向搜索。随后，我们求解多机器人、多目标运动规划问题；在执行时，将规划拆分为接触丰富的装配技能和自由空间运动。我们在多种多零件装配上对规划器进行基准测试，并将其应用于尺寸和运动学不同的机器人群体。我们在物理仿真和真实环境中验证了该工作。视频和代码见 https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap。
items.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation
items.title_en: ConceptPose: Training-Free Zero-Shot Object Pose Estimation using Concept Vectors
items.title_zh: ConceptPose：使用概念向量的免训练零样本物体位姿估计
items.abstract_en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental task in computer vision and robotics, yet most methods require extensive, dataset-specific training. Concurrently, large-scale vision language models show remarkable zero-shot capabilities. In this work, we bridge these two worlds by introducing ConceptPose, a framework for object pose estimation that is both training-free and model-free. ConceptPose leverages a vision-language-model (VLM) to create open-vocabulary 3D concept maps, where each point is tagged with a concept vector derived from saliency maps. By establishing robust 3D-3D correspondences across concept maps, our approach allows precise estimation of 6DoF relative pose. Without any object or dataset-specific training, our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on common zero shot relative pose estimation benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by a relative 62% in average ADD(-S) score, including methods that utilize extensive dataset-specific training.
items.abstract_zh: 物体位姿估计是计算机视觉和机器人学的基础任务，但大多数方法需要大量数据集特定训练。同时，大规模视觉语言模型展现出显著的零样本能力。在本工作中，我们通过引入ConceptPose来连接这两个世界，这是一个既免训练又免模型的物体位姿估计框架。ConceptPose利用视觉语言模型（VLM）创建开放词汇3D概念图，其中每个点都标记有由显著图得到的概念向量。通过在概念图之间建立稳健的3D-3D对应关系，我们的方法可以精确估计6DoF相对位姿。无需任何针对物体或数据集的训练，我们的方法在常见的零样本相对位姿估计基准上取得最先进结果，平均ADD(-S)分数相对最强基线提升62%，包括使用大量数据集特定训练的方法。
items.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026

rm.usage: 免训练、免模型的 6DoF 物体位姿估计思路，可用于工程机器人对科技核心/能量单元等新目标快速建立位姿估计，减少标注训练；但 VLM 概念图算力开销大、精度是否满足装配容差需实测，不能直接当装配视觉伺服方案。

items.title_en: Pressure Drop: Gravity Vector Estimation from a Distributed Barometric Pressure Sensor Array
items.title_zh: 压降：基于分布式气压传感器阵列的重力矢量估计
items.abstract_en: While gravity is often used in mobile robotics as a global constraint for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithms, most estimation methods rely on indirect observation of the gravity vector. In this paper, we propose the use of altimeter measurements to directly observe the direction of the gravity vector. We provide a theoretical evaluation of the estimation noise and validate it through extensive experimental data, along with an evaluation of the impact of intersensor distance on our gravity vector estimates. Experimental results demonstrate that a median error of $0.87^\circ$ on the tilt estimation can be achieved with our system in semi-static scenarios. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of this approach by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods based on Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs). We highlight that we achieve similar performance to that of IMU-based systems in highly dynamic scenarios and even outperform in specific cases of accelerometer measurement saturation. Finally, an additional experiment shows the potential use within a robotic system through the integration into an Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm.
items.abstract_zh: 在移动机器人中，重力常被用作同时定位与建图（SLAM）算法的全局约束，但大多数估计方法依赖对重力矢量的间接观测。本文提出利用高度计测量直接观测重力矢量的方向。我们给出估计噪声的理论评估，并通过大量实验数据进行验证，同时评估传感器间距对重力矢量估计的影响。实验结果表明，在半静态场景中，我们的系统可实现0.87°的中位倾斜估计误差。此外，我们通过与基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的最先进方法进行比较，展示了该方法的潜力。我们强调，在高动态场景中，我们达到与基于IMU的系统相似的性能，甚至在加速度计测量饱和的特定情况下表现更优。最后，另一项实验通过将方法集成到迭代最近点（ICP）算法中，展示了其在机器人系统内的潜在用途。
items.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027

items.title_en: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
items.title_zh: 在仿真中训练推理模型以原生使用真实机器人
items.abstract_en: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. However, strong performance has so far been achieved only by frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, whereas open-weight models remain substantially less capable. We show that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained to use real robots natively through reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations. Like a computer-use agent (CUA), the model observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and generates the next end-effector pose, without any harness. We build a Post-training Engine for Agentic Robotics (PEAR) and use it to train the model on simulated robot tasks at scale with robot-use reinforcement learning (RURL), mirroring how frontier models acquire computer use. We find that the skills acquired in simulation generalize well beyond the training tasks: they transfer to an unseen robot, to the real world, and to novel instructions. After training on LIBERO and RoboDojo in simulation, the model succeeds in 60% of our trials on a real dual-arm robot, whereas the base model succeeds in none. On LIBERO, training raises the success rate from 1.6% to 74.4%, approaching GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at maximum reasoning effort. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on demonstrations, our model is substantially more robust to changes in the task itself. On LIBERO-Pro, $π_{0.5}$ succeeds in only 0.75% of episodes when assigned a new task in a familiar scene whereas our model succeeds in 57.4%. Finally, the model retains its general capabilities, with no measurable degradation on nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks. These results highlight robot-use reinforcement learning as a promising component of foundation-model post-training.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人使用智能体（RUA）已成为通用机器人控制的一种有前景的方法。然而，迄今为止，只有 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.2 等前沿专有模型取得了强劲性能，而开放权重模型的能力仍明显较弱。我们表明，一个开放权重的 27B 推理模型可以通过强化学习被训练为原生使用真实机器人，整个过程完全在仿真中进行且无需演示。与计算机使用智能体（CUA）类似，该模型观察环境、进行思维链推理，并生成下一个末端执行器位姿，无需任何封装框架。我们构建了面向智能体机器人的后训练引擎（PEAR），并使用它通过机器人使用强化学习（RURL）在大规模仿真机器人任务上训练该模型，这与前沿模型获得计算机使用能力的方式类似。我们发现，在仿真中获得的技能能够很好地泛化到训练任务之外：它们可以迁移到未见过的机器人、真实世界以及新指令。在仿真中的 LIBERO 和 RoboDojo 上训练后，该模型在真实双臂机器人上的试验中成功率为 60%，而基础模型无一成功。在 LIBERO 上，训练将成功率从 1.6% 提升至 74.4%，接近 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 在最大推理强度下的水平。与在演示数据上微调的视觉-语言-动作模型 π0.5 相比，我们的模型对任务本身的变化具有显著更强的鲁棒性。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，当在熟悉场景中分配新任务时，π0.5 仅在 0.75% 的回合中成功，而我们的模型成功率为 57.4%。最后，该模型保留了其通用能力，在九个推理、编程与视觉基准上未出现可测量的退化。这些结果凸显了机器人使用强化学习作为基础模型后训练中一个有前景的组成部分。

items.title_en: SAM-VTP: Video Memory and Measured Geometry for Continuous Traversability Segmentation
items.title_zh: SAM-VTP：用于连续可通行性分割的视频记忆与实测几何
items.abstract_en: Traversability prediction is a core component of autonomous navigation, yet most vision-based methods operate frame-wise and produce temporally inconsistent predictions. We present SAM-VTP (Video Traversability Prediction), which fine-tunes SAM2's video memory pathway for dense, prompt-free traversability segmentation, conditioning each frame on a persistent memory of prior observations. Rather than inferring terrain geometry from appearance, we measure it: slope, roughness and height are computed from depth and fused into the image features. We also introduce an offline continuous supervision pipeline that generates dense per-pixel traversability targets in [0,1] from depth-derived geometry and semantic priors, requiring no robot deployment and no per-pixel annotation, capturing conditional feasibility that binary labels cannot represent. On TartanGround, a large-scale synthetic ground-robot dataset, SAM-VTP improves fuzzy Jaccard from 0.908 to 0.924 and binary IoU from 0.854 to 0.886 over SAM-TP, a frame-wise SAM2 baseline, against a seed-to-seed spread below 0.001, and cuts frame-to-frame flicker by 31%. In closed-loop trials at two field sites, driving the same planner and controller, the baseline's dropouts leave the planner without a feasible path 3.3x more often on a paved course and 6.9x on rough ground, while SAM-VTP runs at 21.4 FPS on the Orin Nano the robot carries.
items.abstract_zh: 可通行性预测是自主导航的核心组成部分，然而大多数基于视觉的方法逐帧运行并产生时间上不一致的预测。我们提出SAM-VTP（视频可通行性预测），它微调SAM2的视频记忆通路，用于稠密、无提示的可通行性分割，使每一帧以先前观测的持久记忆为条件。我们不从外观推断地形几何，而是测量它：坡度、粗糙度和高度由深度计算，并融合到图像特征中。我们还引入一种离线连续监督流水线，从深度导出几何和语义先验生成[0,1]范围内的稠密逐像素可通行性目标，无需机器人部署和逐像素标注，捕捉二值标签无法表示的条件可行性。在TartanGround这一大规模合成地面机器人数据集上，SAM-VTP相较于逐帧SAM2基线SAM-TP，将模糊Jaccard从0.908提高到0.924，将二值IoU从0.854提高到0.886，而种子间波动低于0.001，并将帧间闪烁减少31%。在两个野外场地的闭环试验中，驱动相同的规划器和控制器，基线的中断使规划器没有可行路径的情况在铺装路面上多3.3倍，在崎岖地面上多6.9倍，而SAM-VTP在机器人携带的Orin Nano上以21.4 FPS运行。
items.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

items.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
items.title_zh: DPGS-SLAM：面向动态视觉感知的扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Objects in dynamic motion remain a significant challenge for dense visual SLAM since dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction. Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2. For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while metric depth predicted from completed images initializes provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D datasets. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出DPGS-SLAM（扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅SLAM），用于包含动态对象的环境中的稠密建图。动态观测会污染视觉SLAM（同时定位与建图）中的相机跟踪和场景重建。尽管3DGS（三维高斯泼溅）能够实现高效稠密建图，但现有3DGS-SLAM系统在动态对象违反其底层静态场景假设时可能表现出不稳定性。排除动态观测可以减少其对跟踪和建图的影响，但可能使被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束较弱。我们提出的DPGS-SLAM是一种单目RGB SLAM框架，通过异步扩散式背景补全和来源感知高斯建图，支持对观测不足的静态背景进行临时表示。动态区域通过基于光流的运动发现和SAM2（segment anything model 2）的时间一致掩码传播来识别。对于选定的关键帧，微调的扩散修复模型在遮挡区域生成合理的背景外观，而Metric3D v2从补全图像预测度量深度以初始化临时高斯基元。来源标签区分生成基元和观测支持的基元，将生成内容排除在相机位姿估计和观测地图优化之外。当先前被遮挡的背景变为可见时，符合条件生成基元被移除，观测支持的基元从真实RGB观测和预测深度独立初始化。实验结果表明具有竞争力的相机跟踪，在TUM RGB-D上的平均ATE RMSE为1.2 cm，在BONN RGB-D上为2.7 cm。在StaDy4D上，DPGS-SLAM仅使用单目RGB输入，将平均PSNR较WildGS-SLAM提高4.60 dB。

rm.usage: 单目3DGS SLAM中先用光流加SAM2掩膜剔除动态区域，再补全背景，可借鉴这套动态鲁棒思路，减少场上高速运动机器人对哨兵定位与建图的污染；3DGS稠密建图开销大，仅作方法参考。

items.title_en: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
items.title_zh: 面向低功耗机器人自主性的能量感知开放词汇检测调度
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够搜索运行时目标查询，但固定频率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视角期间将嵌入式计算花费在低价值帧上。本文提出一种用于低功耗移动机器人的能量感知OVD调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度，在Jetson Orin Nano上的低、中、高功耗YOLO-World-S模式之间切换。我们在AgileX LIMO上使用40次真实导航试验评估能量-质量权衡：两个目标物体，每个目标-策略对五种放置，以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器记录8/10任务成功，而每个固定频率基线为7/10，同时相对于8 Hz高频基线将Jetson平均输入功率（Jetson侧功耗指标）降低5.2%，并将实际OVD调用率降低34.0%。它并未最小化任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量，因为更长的任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。单独的60 s静止微基准隔离感知工作负载：相对于8 Hz基线，调度器将平均功率从8.045 W降至7.301 W，能量从484.7 J降至438.1 J。这些结果支持机器人状态感知的OVD调度作为一种有前景的电源管理机制，并具有有竞争力的任务可靠性，同时表明任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量必须与任务进度和运行时间一起解读。
items.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, accepted for publication in ICARCV 2026

items.title_en: An Open MuJoCo Simulation Framework for a Quadrotor Carrying a Tendon-Driven Soft Continuum Arm
items.title_zh: 用于搭载腱驱动软连续臂的四旋翼的开源 MuJoCo 仿真框架
items.abstract_en: Combining aerial robots with soft continuum manipulators promises safe, compliant interaction with the environment, but the coupled dynamics of a free-flying base and a highly deformable, underactuated arm are difficult to study without a suitable simulator. This paper describes an open-source simulation framework, built on the MuJoCo physics engine, for a quadrotor that carries a tendon-driven soft continuum arm underneath its body. The arm is modelled as a pseudo-rigid-body chain of twelve segments joined by pairs of orthogonal compliant hinges. Three tendons, spaced \SI{120}{\degree} apart and routed through every segment, bend it in any direction. A geometric tracking controller on $SE(3)$ flies the vehicle; its rotor allocation matrix is generated directly from the model description. A closed-form tendon-tension allocation keeps every tension within its limits and gives the same bending moment in every direction. We report the full set of modelling choices and parameters, and we evaluate the framework in four simulated scenarios: a \SI{36}{\second} mission with a figure-eight and a tendon-driven tip sweep, an attitude-gain study, a quasi-static characterization of the bending workspace, and an impulsive disturbance applied to the arm tip. With the nominal gains the vehicle tracks the mission with \SI{3.1}{\centi\meter} RMS position error while the arm tip swings up to \SI{37}{\centi\meter} from the body axis. The gain study shows that a low-bandwidth attitude loop lets the arm excite sustained oscillations. The simulation runs about $15\times$ faster than real time on a laptop CPU. All models, controllers and scripts that reproduce the figures are released.
items.abstract_zh: 将空中机器人与软连续操作器相结合，有望实现与环境安全、柔顺的交互，但如果没有合适的仿真器，自由飞行基座与高度可变形、欠驱动臂的耦合动力学难以研究。本文描述一个基于 MuJoCo 物理引擎的开源仿真框架，用于在机体下方搭载腱驱动软连续臂的四旋翼。该臂被建模为由十二个段组成的伪刚体链，各段通过成对的正交柔性铰链连接。三根腱彼此间隔 120°，并穿过每个段布置，可使其向任意方向弯曲。SE(3) 上的几何跟踪控制器控制飞行器；其旋翼分配矩阵直接由模型描述生成。闭式腱张力分配使每根腱的张力保持在其限制范围内，并在每个方向产生相同弯矩。我们报告完整的建模选择与参数，并在四个仿真场景中评估该框架：一个包含八字形运动和腱驱动末端扫掠的 36 秒任务、一项姿态增益研究、弯曲工作空间的准静态表征，以及施加于臂端的脉冲扰动。在标称增益下，飞行器以 3.1 厘米 RMS 位置误差跟踪任务，而臂端从机体轴摆动高达 37 厘米。增益研究表明，低带宽姿态环会让臂激发持续振荡。该仿真在笔记本电脑 CPU 上运行速度约为实时的 15 倍。所有可复现这些图表的模型、控制器和脚本均已发布。

items.title_en: ECO-ID: Event-Camera based Optical System for Secure Multi-User Ultra-Low Latency Identification
items.title_zh: ECO-ID：基于事件相机的多用户超低时延安全光学识别系统
items.abstract_en: Time-critical interactive systems increasingly require ultra-low-latency device identification for multiple users, yet prevailing approaches such as passwords, QR codes, and RFID/NFC are constrained by human input, frame-based sensing, or near-contact range. This paper presents ECO-ID, an event-camera-based optical system for multi-user, ultra-low-latency identification over visible light communication (VLC). Leveraging microsecond-resolution, asynchronous observations of brightness transitions, ECO-ID employs a spatiotemporal coding design: disjoint LED subsets provide spatial separation among users, while user-specific timing delays encode identities without inter-user synchronization. The optical channel and event-driven sensing reduce full-scene capture relative to frame cameras and limit the RF attack surface, while enabling rapid token verification with freshness and replay protection. We implement a prototype and demonstrate that ECO-ID can practically achieve approximately 99.8\% localization and 98.7\% identification with 0.64 ms mean latency, while theoretically supporting identification at the scale of tens of concurrent users. Overall, ECO-ID provides a fast, privacy-conscious, and security-aware alternative for scalable multi-user identification in time-critical interactive environments.
items.abstract_zh: 时间敏感的交互系统日益需要面向多用户的超低时延设备识别，而密码、二维码、RFID/NFC等主流方式受限于人工输入、帧式传感或近距接触。本文提出ECO-ID，一种基于事件相机、通过可见光通信（VLC）实现多用户超低时延识别的光学系统。它利用事件相机对亮度跃变微秒级、异步的观测能力，采用时空编码设计：互不相交的LED子集在空间上区分不同用户，用户特定的时延则在不需用户间同步的情况下编码身份。光学信道与事件驱动传感减少了对整幅场景的采集，也缩小了射频攻击面，同时支持带新鲜性校验与重放保护的快速凭证验证。原型实验表明，ECO-ID 可实现约99.8%的定位率与98.7%的识别率，平均时延 0.64 ms，理论上可支持数十个并发用户。
items.highlight_zh: 事件相机+LED时空编码，实现0.64毫秒多用户光学身份识别
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：在需要即时响应的交互场景（如多人同时操作的大屏、AR/VR、门禁）中，设备要快速认出“现在是谁在操作”。密码要人输入、二维码要人举起来对准、RFID/NFC则要求贴近，且基于帧的摄像头天生有延迟。作者要解决的是：如何让多个用户几乎无感地、在毫秒级被识别出来。

二、用了什么方法：用事件相机作为接收器。事件相机不像普通摄像头那样逐帧曝光，而是只在像素亮度发生变化时异步输出事件，时间分辨率达微秒级。作者设计了时空联合编码：空间上，给不同用户分配互不重叠的LED子集，靠位置区分人；时间上，给每个用户设定专属的发光时延，靠“节奏”编码身份，而且不需要用户之间做时钟同步。安全方面，光信道不易被远程窃听，事件相机只记录变化而非整幅画面，也缩小了射频攻击面，并配合新鲜性校验与防重放机制。

三、有什么结果：作者做出原型系统，实测定位准确率约99.8%、身份识别准确率约98.7%，平均时延仅0.64 ms；分析表明该方案在原理上可扩展到数十个并发用户。

四、为何重要：它给出了一条不依赖人工操作、不依赖射频、且兼顾隐私与安全的识别路径，适用于对延迟极敏感的多人交互场景，是对二维码与RFID等方案的有力补充。
items.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, and 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE globecom

items.title_en: Channel Modeling and LED Spot Detection for Dense Image-Sensor Visible Light Communication
items.title_zh: 密集图像传感器可见光通信的信道建模与LED光斑检测
items.abstract_en: High-density LED arrays enable high-speed transmission in image-sensor-based visible-light communication (VLC) systems. However, when optical spots become blurred and spatially overlapped due to focal shift, resolution limitations, or interference, severe inter-symbol interference (ISI) occurs, significantly degrading decoding performance. Furthermore, radial distortion introduces geometric deformation of the LED grid, while vignetting leads to incomplete and asymmetric spot shapes at the periphery, both of which further hinder reliable signal detection. Existing methods mitigate ISI by reducing LED transmission signaling density. This paper proposes a robust decoding framework that maintains full LED signaling density. We introduce a pilot-aided geometric recognition method that uses a PSF-constrained Hough transform and circle-center alignment refinement. \textbf{In addition, radial distortion correction and vignetting-aware compensation are incorporated to restore geometric consistency and suppress edge-related detection errors.} By leveraging prior structural knowledge from pilot frames, the system effectively separates overlapping LED signals under severe optical distortion. Experimental results on a real-world VLC testbed confirm that the proposed method achieves superior decoding accuracy and throughput compared to conventional Hough-based and low-density baseline methods. The results highlight its potential for high-efficiency VLC applications in interference-prone environments.
items.abstract_zh: 高密度LED阵列可在基于图像传感器的可见光通信（VLC）系统中实现高速传输。但当离焦、分辨率受限或干扰导致光斑模糊并空间重叠时，会产生严重的符号间干扰（ISI），显著降低解码性能。此外，径向畸变使LED网格发生几何形变，渐晕则造成边缘光斑形状不完整且不对称，这些都进一步妨碍可靠检测。现有方法通过降低LED发送密度来缓解ISI。本文提出一种在保持全LED发送密度下仍能稳健解码的框架，引入基于导频的几何识别方法，采用受点扩散函数（PSF）约束的Hough变换与圆心对齐精修，并结合径向畸变校正与渐晕感知补偿，以恢复几何一致性、抑制边缘检测误差。借助导频帧提供的先验结构知识，系统可在严重光学畸变下分离重叠的LED信号。在真实VLC测试平台上的实验表明，该方法相较传统Hough类方法与低密度基线在解码准确率和吞吐量上均有优势。
items.highlight_zh: 保持全LED密度，用PSF约束Hough变换分离重叠光斑
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：用手机或工业相机拍摄LED阵列来做可见光通信时，LED越密、速率越高，但实际拍摄中光斑会因离焦、分辨率不足或相邻干扰而变糊、互相重叠，造成严重的符号间干扰（ISI）。同时镜头的径向畸变会把本来规整的LED网格“拉弯”，渐晕又让画面边缘的光斑变暗、残缺、不对称，这些都会让解码出错。以往的做法是少开一些LED（降低发送密度）来换取清晰度，代价是速率下降。

二、用了什么方法：作者坚持不降低LED密度，转而用“先验知识”来解题。系统先发送导频帧，让接收端知道LED阵列本应长什么样；再据此做几何识别——把光斑的形状特性（点扩散函数，PSF）作为约束嵌入Hough变换来检测圆斑，并用圆心对齐做亚像素级精修；同时估计并校正径向畸变、对渐晕做感知补偿，把边缘区域“拉回”正常形态。有了这些几何约束，即使光斑严重重叠也能被分离出来。

三、有什么结果：在真实VLC测试平台上，该方法的解码准确率和吞吐量都优于传统基于Hough变换的方法以及低密度发送的基线方案，说明“不牺牲密度也能可靠解码”是可行的。

四、为何重要：它把限制高速图像传感器VLC的瓶颈从“硬件光学缺陷”转化为“可利用的先验信息”，在干扰严重、镜头质量一般的现实环境中依然能跑高吞吐，为密集LED阵列VLC的实用化扫清了一大障碍。

items.title_en: Real-world Latency Analysis of Vehicular Visible Light Communication with Multiple LED Transmitters and an Event-Based Camera
items.title_zh: 多LED发射机与事件相机车联网可见光通信的真实场景时延分析
items.abstract_en: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution, low latency, and wide dynamic range, making them promising receivers for visible light communication (VLC) in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) applications. This work presents an event-camera-based VLC system addressing three key challenges: bandwidth saturation, multi-transmitter reception, and latency characterization. We adopt a positive-event-only mode and design a protocol that suppresses event generation while maintaining communication distance and a wide field of view. We also propose a method to identify multiple transmitters and demonstrate simultaneous reception from up to three LEDs. Finally, we evaluate end-to-end latency in real vehicular scenarios and show that the system meets cooperative perception requirements. These results demonstrate that event-camera-based VLC is a feasible complement to existing V2X technologies (e.g., RF).
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率、低时延和宽动态范围，是车联网（V2X）中可见光通信（VLC）颇具前景的接收器。本文提出一种基于事件相机的VLC系统，应对带宽饱和、多发射机接收与时延刻画三大挑战。作者采用仅正事件模式，并设计协议以抑制事件产生，同时保持通信距离与宽视场；提出多发射机识别方法，演示了最多三盏LED的同时接收；最后在真实车辆场景中评估端到端时延，表明系统满足协同感知的需求。结果说明基于事件相机的VLC可作为现有V2X技术（如射频）的可行补充。
items.highlight_zh: 事件相机车联网VLC实测端到端时延，可支持三灯同时接收
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：车与车、车与路之间的通信（V2X）目前主要靠射频，但射频在拥堵信道和高密度场景下会受限。可见光通信可作为补充——车灯本来就在发光。问题是：普通相机帧率太低、延迟太大；而事件相机虽然响应极快（微秒级）、动态范围宽，用在车上却有三个实际障碍：事件输出速率太高会把带宽“撑爆”；一辆车视野里往往有多盏灯同时发送，怎么区分；以及在真实道路条件下端到端到底有多快，此前不清楚。

二、用了什么方法：作者采用“只取正事件”的工作模式（只响应变亮），并设计了一套协议主动抑制事件产生量，从而在保住通信距离和大视场的前提下避免数据洪流。针对多发射机，提出用空间位置区分不同LED的方法，实现最多三盏LED同时接收。最后搭建真实车载场景，测量从发到收的端到端时延。

三、有什么结果：系统能够同时接收三盏LED的信号，且端到端时延满足协同感知（车辆间共享感知数据）的实时性要求，证明该方案在真实车辆场景中可用。

四、为何重要：它把事件相机VLC从实验室演示推进到真实车辆场景，系统性地回答了“带宽够不够、多灯能不能分、快不快”这三个决定能否落地的关键问题，说明光通信可以成为射频V2X的实用补充。

items.title_en: An Open-Source Research Platform for Embedded Visible Light Networking
items.abstract_en: Despite the growing interest in Visible Light Communication (VLC), a reference networking platform based on commercial off-the-shelf components is not available yet. An open-source platform would lower the barriers to entry to VLC network research and help the VLC community gain momentum. We introduce OpenVLC, an open-source VLC research platform based on software-defined implementation. Built around a credit-card-sized embedded Linux platform with a simple opto-electronic transceiver front-end, OpenVLC offers a basic physical layer, a set of essential medium access primitives, as well as interoperability with Internet protocols. We investigate the performance of OpenVLC and show examples of how it can be used along with standard network diagnostics tools. Our software-defined implementation can currently reach throughput in the order of the basic rate of IEEE 802.15.7 standard. We discuss several techniques that researchers and engineers could introduce to improve the performance of OpenVLC and envision several directions that can benefit from OpenVLC by adopting it as a reference platform.
items.title_zh: 一个面向嵌入式可见光网络的的开源研究平台
items.abstract_zh: 尽管可见光通信（VLC）受到越来越多的关注，但基于商用现成组件的参考网络平台仍未出现。一个开源平台将降低VLC网络研究的入门门槛，并有助于VLC社区形成声势。我们推出OpenVLC——一个基于软件定义实现的开源VLC研究平台。OpenVLC围绕信用卡大小的嵌入式Linux平台构建，配有简单的光电收发前端，提供基础物理层、一组必要的介质访问原语，以及与互联网协议的互操作性。我们考察了OpenVLC的性能，并展示其如何与标准网络诊断工具配合使用的示例。我们的软件定义实现目前可达到与IEEE 802.15.7标准基本速率相当量级的吞吐量。我们讨论了研究人员与工程师可用于提升OpenVLC性能的若干技术，并展望了采用它作为参考平台而受益的多个方向。
items.highlight_zh: 推出开源软件定义可见光通信研究平台OpenVLC
items.digest_zh:
本研究要解决的问题是：可见光通信（VLC）研究热度上升，但社区缺少一个基于商用现成器件、可复现的参考网络平台，导致入门门槛高、各家实验难以对比。

作者的做法是构建 OpenVLC：硬件上采用信用卡大小的嵌入式 Linux 单板计算机，外接一个简单的光电收发前端；软件上采用软件定义的方式，自行实现基础物理层、若干必要的介质访问控制原语，并让系统能够与标准互联网协议互通，从而把 VLC 链路接入常规网络栈。

在结果方面，作者测量了 OpenVLC 的实际性能，并用标准网络诊断工具做了演示性实验，说明该平台可直接沿用现有网络调试方法；当前吞吐量达到 IEEE 802.15.7 标准基本速率的量级，属于可用但仍有提升空间的原型水平。文中还讨论了研究者可采用的若干性能改进手段。

其重要性在于：开源与低成本降低了 VLC 组网研究的门槛，使更多团队能复现与比较实验结果，有助于该领域形成共同基准；同时软件定义的架构便于快速试验新协议与新算法。它为可见光通信从点对点链路走向真正的网络化研究提供了可共享的起点。

optical_review.reason_zh: OpenVLC早期开放原型把OOK、曼彻斯特编码、介质访问与网络接口连成可运行系统，适合参考低成本嵌入式可见光链路的分层实现。
optical_review.limitations_zh: 2015论文的初始实现以LED兼作探测器，不能与后续OpenVLC光电二极管版本混同；BeagleBone平台及旧驱动需要移植，不代表可直接装到轻型无人机或直接满足比赛灯光限制。

items.title_en: SE(3)-LIVOM: Adaptive Multi-LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry and Mapping
items.title_zh: SE(3)-LIVOM：自适应多激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计与建图
items.abstract_en: This paper presents SE(3)-LIVOM, the overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026. The challenge asks for the trajectory of a legged robot in the GrandTour dataset, whose scenes include collapsed buildings, construction sites and snowfields. SE(3)-LIVOM runs in real time on two LiDARs, one camera and an IMU. Its frontend extends SE(3)-LIO to multiple LiDARs and a camera. Adaptive downsampling keeps the time per scan near 35 ms within and across scenes. An online backend corrects drift with a plane bundle adjustment over submaps and an incremental pose graph. With a single configuration for all scenes, the system reaches an average ATE of 1.40 cm on the six test scenes. The code is available at https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 SE(3)-LIVOM，它是 IROS 2026 上 COMFORT Challenge 的总冠军。该挑战要求给出 GrandTour 数据集中腿式机器人的轨迹，其场景包括倒塌建筑、建筑工地和雪地。SE(3)-LIVOM 在两台激光雷达、一个相机和一个 IMU 上实时运行。其前端将 SE(3)-LIO 扩展到多台激光雷达和一个相机。自适应降采样使场景内和跨场景的每扫描时间保持在接近 35 ms。在线后端通过子图上的平面光束法平差和增量位姿图来校正漂移。对所有场景使用单一配置，该系统在六个测试场景上达到平均 ATE 1.40 cm。代码见 https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort。
items.comment: 3 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge, IROS 2026 Workshop on Data in Field Robotics. Code: https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort

items.title_en: How Uncertain Is My Action? Self-Correcting Visual Planning with Frozen World Models
items.title_zh: 我的动作有多不确定？使用冻结世界模型的自校正视觉规划
items.abstract_en: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. On PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube with a frozen latent world model, measured detection follows the prediction to within 0.05 AUROC. Self-correction raises success from 0.650 to 0.862 on PushT and from 0.378 to 0.432 on the harder Cube task, levels with an oracle that is told the true shift at the same block, better than five common test-time adaptation methods. On a real robotic arm, the score identifies a base-joint offset that no joint encoder registers and reduces the reach error from 36 mm to 3-5 mm, and under shifts drawn at random and sealed before the session, estimates recover 92-94% of the error reduction achieved with the true shift. The broader implication is that a frozen world model can act as a filter by predicting the future, testing action-interface uncertainty and validity, and finally correcting failures.
items.abstract_zh: 冻结的潜世界模型与基于采样的模型预测控制相结合构成视觉规划器。在部署时，执行动作可能偏离指令动作，而冻结模型无法察觉。我们表明该模型可以反向运行：对于任何假设的执行偏移，它预测在该偏移下本应观察到的内容，并将该预测与实际观察到的内容进行比较，从而量化该偏移并使规划器自我校正。与将偏移与模型自身误差混合的残差能量不同，该评分仅保留偏移可能产生的那部分残差。该偏移评分使用局部最优检验检测偏移，用Cramer-Rao误差条估计偏移，识别主导生成源，并在警报触发后补偿规划器。在使用冻结潜世界模型的PushT、TwoRoom和OGBench-Cube上，实测检测结果与预测的偏差在0.05 AUROC以内。自校正将PushT上的成功率从0.650提高到0.862，在更难的Cube任务上从0.378提高到0.432，与在同一区块被告知真实偏移的oracle持平，优于五种常见的测试时自适应方法。在真实机械臂上，该评分识别出没有关节编码器记录的基座关节偏移，并将到达误差从36 mm降低到3-5 mm；在会话前密封并随机抽取的偏移下，估计值恢复了使用真实偏移所实现误差降低的92-94%。更广泛的含义是，冻结世界模型可以通过预测未来、检验动作接口的不确定性和有效性，并最终校正失败，从而充当滤波器。

items.title_en: BoBDeLaN: Bounded-Bandwidth Context Adaptation for Deep Lagrangian Robot Control
items.title_zh: BoBDeLaN：用于深度拉格朗日机器人控制的有界带宽上下文适应
items.abstract_en: Learned physics-based models provide structure for robot control, but uncertain payloads and unmodeled dynamics limit their predictive accuracy. Context-aware Deep Lagrangian Networks enable adaptation through a latent context inferred from measurement histories while retaining Lagrangian structure for each fixed context. However, this structure alone does not constrain sensitivity to measurement disturbances. We introduce BoBDeLaN, which combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to shape disturbance sensitivity across frequencies. This architecture guarantees exponential forgetting of the recurrent initialization and admits a finite-horizon, frequency-weighted bound on context perturbations, which extends to residual torque prediction under a Lipschitz continuity assumption on the context-conditioned dynamics model. We evaluate a low-pass realization within model predictive control on simulated and real hardware manipulation tasks, together with frequency-sensitivity analysis on real-robot data. Compared with an LSTM encoder using the same input filter, BoBDeLaN exhibits reduced high-frequency context sensitivity, lower residual torque prediction error, and smoother motion, with less degradation under injected disturbances.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习的物理模型为机器人控制提供了结构，但不确定的有效载荷和未建模动力学限制了其预测精度。上下文感知的深度拉格朗日网络通过从测量历史推断的潜在上下文实现适应，同时针对每个固定上下文保留拉格朗日结构。然而，仅此结构并不能约束对测量扰动的敏感性。我们提出 BoBDeLaN，它将收缩的、增益有界的循环平衡网络（Recurrent Equilibrium Network）上下文编码器与稳定线性滤波相结合，以塑造跨频率的扰动敏感性。该架构保证循环初始化的指数遗忘，并允许对上下文扰动给出有限时域、频率加权的界，在上下文条件动力学模型满足 Lipschitz 连续性假设下，该界可扩展到残差力矩预测。我们在仿真和真实硬件操作任务中，在模型预测控制内评估了一种低通实现，并在真实机器人数据上进行了频率敏感性分析。与使用相同输入滤波器的 LSTM 编码器相比，BoBDeLaN 表现出更低的高频上下文敏感性、更低的残差力矩预测误差和更平滑的运动，并且在注入扰动下退化更少。
items.comment: Submitted to the 9th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC 2027)

items.title_en: CLIFT: Contrastive LiDAR Instance Features for 3D Pedestrian Tracking
items.title_zh: CLIFT：用于3D行人跟踪的对比式LiDAR实例特征
items.abstract_en: A social robot has to keep track of the people around it over time to plan its motion, a task handled by 3D multi-object tracking. For the LiDAR modality, trackers usually sit on top of a detector and link its detections across frames with a separate motion model or re-identification network. We instead show how a 3D LiDAR detector itself can be turned into a tracker by adding an instance-level contrastive objective on its intermediate voxel features. Each embedding is read from the voxels inside a detected box, and boxes are matched across frames by cosine similarity and the Hungarian algorithm, without a motion model. The detector backbone is fine-tuned together with this objective, which learns identity-aware features while leaving detection accuracy essen- tially intact. Because the method uses only the voxel features that Li- DAR detectors already produce, it is backbone-agnostic. On the JRDB 3D tracking leaderboard our LiDAR-only tracker ranks first on HOTA (38.58) and IDF1 (37.99), 13.04 and 9.30 points above the next pub- lished method, and second on MOTA and OSPA. Code is available at https://hermak56.github.io/CLIFT/.
items.abstract_zh: 社交机器人必须随时间跟踪周围的人员以规划其运动，这项任务由3D多目标跟踪处理。对于LiDAR模态，跟踪器通常位于检测器之上，并使用单独的运动模型或重识别网络将检测结果跨帧关联。相反，我们展示如何通过在3D LiDAR检测器的中间体素特征上添加实例级对比目标，将检测器本身转变为跟踪器。每个嵌入从检测框内的体素中读取，框通过余弦相似度和匈牙利算法跨帧匹配，无需运动模型。检测器骨干网络与该目标一起微调，学习身份感知特征，同时基本保持检测精度不变。由于该方法仅使用LiDAR检测器已经产生的体素特征，因此与骨干网络无关。在JRDB 3D跟踪排行榜上，我们仅使用LiDAR的跟踪器在HOTA（38.58）和IDF1（37.99）上排名第一，分别比下一个已发表方法高出13.04和9.30分，并在MOTA和OSPA上排名第二。代码见 https://hermak56.github.io/CLIFT/。

rm.usage: 激光雷达检测器加实例对比特征做多目标跟踪的方法，思路可类比雷达站的多目标数据关联与ID保持，但本文是行人跟踪且未涉及装甲板识别与赛场条件，需大幅改造。

items.title_en: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
items.title_zh: OrthoMark：基于点锚定正交高度标记的地点识别
items.abstract_en: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR地点识别为同步定位与建图（SLAM）提供回环闭合。从Z轴视角看，重力对齐的扫描是场景的正交图，而从另一位置和航向的重访会使该图在平面内刚性移动，这种运动被极坐标傅里叶谱忽略，并由相位相关恢复。沿垂直方向，回波的高度描述结构，但观测到哪些高度取决于距离，因为传感器的垂直视场会截断附近结构的高度；因此高度会误导全局关键帧，但一旦两帧扫描对齐并在重叠处逐单元比较，高度就是决定性的。我们提出 OrthoMark，这是一种无需训练的方法，基于一个原则：两帧LiDAR扫描只能通过从两帧中相同几何表面计算出的特征进行比较。OrthoMark 使用鸟瞰图（BEV）的平移和旋转不变极坐标谱检索候选，每个关键帧1.9 KB，并通过相位相关估计其平面位姿，再用点锚定高度列对其进行评分，以验证每个候选：每个BEV单元保留其自身回波高度的16位掩码；在单次会话内，分数由两帧扫描感知范围的预期重叠加权，该重叠由其距离计算。我们表明，这种垂直联系在验证中有益，但在检索中有害，因为高度切片包含的内容取决于到结构的距离。对于单机器人，在KITTI开发序列上，OrthoMark 在无需3D配准的无训练方法中具有最高AP；跨机器人时，在所有多机器人序列上，它以1/350的描述符大小达到或超过RING++，并在所有测试中比学习到的BEVPlace++闭合更多机器人间回环。

rm.usage: 激光雷达地点识别与回环检测方法，理论上可参考于哨兵或无人机的重定位，但本文面向室外车载KITTI场景，与室内赛场、规则与算力条件差距大，关联较弱。

items.title_en: VisDrone-ReID: A Unified Multi-Category Object Re-Identification Benchmark
items.title_zh: VisDrone-ReID：统一的多类别目标重识别基准
items.abstract_en: Object re-identification (Re-ID) benchmarks remain predominantly confined to single-category evaluations, limiting the development of unified systems capable of operating across diverse object types. This paper presents VisDrone-ReID, a unified multi-category Re-ID benchmark derived from the VisDrone2019-MOT dataset through a principled conversion pipeline. The pipeline resolves structural incompatibilities between multi-object tracking annotations and Re-ID evaluation requirements, addressing sequence-scoped identity collision, temporal redundancy, and the absence of a principled identity-level train/test split. The resulting benchmark comprises 9,516 identities and 150,016 images across ten object categories - pedestrian, people, bicycle, car, van, truck, tricycle, awning-tricycle, bus, and motor, sourced from 80 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sequences captured across urban environments. A leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation protocol is adopted to provide a comprehensive assessment. Baseline experiments across four representative Re-ID models spanning CNN and transformer architectures establish the first systematic performance reference on this benchmark. Results reveal a consistent Rank-1 to mAP gap across all models, suggesting that VisDrone-ReID presents a genuine retrieval challenge beyond nearest-neighbour matching. Per-category analysis identifies pedestrian as the most challenging category and reveals that vision-language pretraining provides a measurable advantage on semantically distinctive categories. VisDrone-ReID provides a consistent platform for studying multi-category object re-identification under the scale variation, viewpoint challenges, and category diversity characteristic of real-world surveillance scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 目标重识别（Re-ID）基准仍然主要局限于单类别评估，限制了能够跨多样目标类型运行的统一系统的发展。本文提出 VisDrone-ReID，这是一个统一的多类别Re-ID基准，通过有原则的转换流程从VisDrone2019-MOT数据集派生而来。该流程解决了多目标跟踪标注与Re-ID评估要求之间的结构不兼容问题，处理了序列范围内的身份冲突、时间冗余以及缺乏有原则的身份级训练/测试划分的问题。所得基准包含来自城市环境中采集的80个无人机（UAV）序列的10个目标类别——行人、人群、自行车、汽车、厢式货车、卡车、三轮车、带篷三轮车、公交车和摩托车——共9,516个身份和150,016张图像。采用留一（LOO）评估协议以提供全面评估。跨CNN和Transformer架构的四个代表性Re-ID模型的基线实验建立了该基准上的首个系统性性能参考。结果揭示了所有模型一致的Rank-1到mAP差距，表明VisDrone-ReID呈现出超越最近邻匹配的真实检索挑战。按类别分析将行人确定为最具挑战性的类别，并揭示视觉-语言预训练在语义上独特的类别上提供了可测量的优势。VisDrone-ReID为研究真实世界监控场景所特有的尺度变化、视角挑战和类别多样性下的多类别目标重识别提供了一个一致的平台。

items.title_en: Grounding Object-to-Object Hazard Reasoning into 3D Risk Fields for Task-Conditioned Safety
items.title_zh: 将物体间危险推理落地为 3D 风险场以实现任务条件化安全
items.abstract_en: Safety in robotics does not solely depend on geometric constraints, but also on semantics: the given task, environment properties, and interactions between objects in the scene. We present a framework based on vision-language models (VLMs) to infer task- and scene-dependent safety constraints for robot manipulation. We provide the VLM a structured safety tool based on an RGB-D observation and a natural-language task instruction that first decides whether the task should be rejected since its execution may result in a non-recoverable hazardous outcome. Otherwise, it identifies preventable object-pair hazards and specifies the spatial relations that must be avoided. Open-vocabulary segmentation and depth information are then used to ground the detected objects in 3D and construct continuous risk fields that represent the corresponding hazardous regions. These fields are integrated with an obstacle avoidance module that corrects nominal robot motions during execution while accounting for the risk field. We evaluate the framework on preventable hazards, tasks requiring rejection, and safe variants in simulation and the real-world. Project website: https://vlm-hazard-riskfield.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 机器人安全不仅取决于几何约束，还取决于语义：给定任务、环境属性以及场景中物体之间的交互。我们提出了一个基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的框架，用于为机器人操作推断依赖任务和场景的安全约束。我们向 VLM 提供一个结构化安全工具，该工具基于 RGB-D 观测和自然语言任务指令，首先判断是否应拒绝该任务，因为其执行可能导致不可恢复的危险后果。否则，它识别可预防的物体对危险，并指定必须避免的空间关系。然后，使用开放词汇分割和深度信息将检测到的物体在 3D 中定位，并构建表示相应危险区域的连续风险场。这些风险场与避障模块集成，该模块在执行过程中考虑风险场并修正标称机器人运动。我们在仿真和真实世界中，针对可预防危险、需要拒绝的任务以及安全变体对该框架进行评估。项目网站：https://vlm-hazard-riskfield.github.io

rm.usage: 用视觉语言模型推断任务相关安全约束并构建3D风险场的思路，可类比用于哨兵导航中把场地语义（禁区、危险交互）转成避障代价；但原文是机械臂操作安全，需重写感知与接口，且算力需求与哨兵平台差距大。

items.title_en: Robot Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance from Randomly Positioned External Cameras
items.title_zh: 基于随机位置外部相机的机器人导航与避障
items.abstract_en: We study robot navigation in indoor environments from fixed exocentric cameras (infrastructure-mounted, external to the robot). We show that standard Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which succeeds with onboard cameras, fails to learn this navigation end-to-end in our setup. This failure results from the perspective mismatch between exocentric observations and egocentric action and goal formulations, which is too complex to resolve from the reward signal alone. To address this, we propose Viewpoint-Invariant Navigation from Exocentric Cameras (VINE). VINE uses an obstacle map estimation network, trained with supervised learning, that takes exocentric images, camera pose, robot pose, and room dimensions as input and produces a viewpoint-invariant obstacle map. This map can be used either by a PPO policy or by a planner such as A*. VINE's map estimation performs better than perspective mapping approaches, handles cameras placed across a wide range of positions and orientations without view-specific tuning, requires only approximate camera pose estimates (noise with a standard deviation of 30cm per axis in x, y, and z and about 20° of rotation error on average), is robust to intrinsic variation, and extends to two-camera setups with partial coverage. Despite operating from cameras randomized in position during evaluation, VINE surpasses the navigation success rate of PPO with an onboard camera in simulated environments.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究在室内环境中利用固定的外中心相机（安装在基础设施上、位于机器人外部）进行机器人导航。我们表明，标准近端策略优化（PPO）在机载相机上能够成功，但在我们的设置中无法端到端地学习这种导航。这一失败源于外中心观测与自我中心动作和目标表述之间的视角不匹配，仅靠奖励信号过于复杂而难以解决。为此，我们提出基于外中心相机的视角不变导航（VINE）。VINE使用一个通过监督学习训练的障碍物地图估计网络，该网络以外中心图像、相机位姿、机器人位姿和房间尺寸为输入，生成视角不变的障碍物地图。该地图可供PPO策略或A*等规划器使用。VINE的地图估计性能优于透视映射方法，能够处理放置在广泛位置和朝向的相机而无需针对视角调参，仅需近似的相机位姿估计（x、y、z每轴标准差30 cm的噪声，平均约20°的旋转误差），对相机内参变化具有鲁棒性，并可扩展到具有部分覆盖的双相机设置。尽管在评估时相机位置随机化，VINE在仿真环境中仍超过了使用机载相机的PPO的导航成功率。
items.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, accepted as a regular paper for the 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration

items.title_en: Visual-Inertial RGB-D SLAM with Encoders for a Differential Wheeled Robot
items.title_zh: 面向差速轮式机器人的带编码器视觉-惯性RGB-D SLAM
items.abstract_en: Recent years have seen multiple impressive results in visual-inertial odometry (VIO) techniques, by which accurate state estimation can be achieved via the extended Kalman filter (EKF) or nonlinear optimization. However, these approaches are rarely open source, and they tend to fail in real experiments due to the temporary lack of feature points and fast motion. Therefore, in this study, we used encoders to overcome the temporary failure of purely vision-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Here, we propose a generative measurement model for encoders and derive an expression for the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and necessary Jacobians for optimization. We use our theory to present a novel tightly coupled visual-inertial encoder RGB-Depth (RGB-D) SLAM system. Tests on our system on an in-house dataset confirmed that our modeling effort led to accurate (with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of approximately 2-7 cm) and robust state estimation in real time. The source code and our dataset containing the encoder information have been published for verification.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）技术取得了多项令人印象深刻的成果，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）或非线性优化可实现准确的状态估计。然而，这些方法很少开源，并且由于特征点暂时缺失和快速运动，往往在真实实验中失败。因此，在本研究中，我们使用编码器来克服纯视觉同时定位与建图（SLAM）的暂时失效。我们提出编码器的生成式测量模型，并推导最大后验（MAP）估计表达式以及优化所需的雅可比矩阵。我们利用该理论提出一种新颖的紧耦合视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-Depth（RGB-D）SLAM系统。在自建数据集上对我们系统的测试证实，我们的建模工作实现了实时、准确（均方根误差（RMSE）约为2–7 cm）且稳健的状态估计。源代码和包含编码器信息的数据集已发布以供验证。
items.comment: 11 pages. Author-accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Sensors Journal, 2022

items.title_en: Learning Direct Control from Optimization for Dynamic Target Tracking
items.title_zh: 从优化中学习直接控制以实现动态目标跟踪
items.abstract_en: Dynamic target tracking requires a mobile robot to maintain target visibility while navigating obstacles with smooth, feasible controls. Online trajectory optimization explicitly encodes these objectives but requires repeated numerical solving, whereas waypoint-based neural policies separate geometric prediction from control execution. We introduce LECO, a framework that transfers tracking optimization into offline learning of a direct-control policy. LECO predicts control sequences and maps them to trajectories through a differentiable kinematic model, allowing trajectory-level objectives to directly guide control learning. A decaying expert-guidance curriculum initializes effective tracking behavior and progressively shifts learning toward these task objectives. At deployment, a predictive safety lock checks short-horizon obstacle clearance and invokes a classical planning and control fallback when the predicted motion is unsafe or the target prediction is invalid. Across three simulated obstacle densities, LECO reduces root-mean-square linear jerk by 14.1--31.2\% relative to the best competing method for this metric and achieves the highest tracking success rate, with per-cycle computation times of 4.25--5.63\,ms. Experiments on two robot platforms further demonstrate tracking through indoor narrow passages and outdoor forest environments. These results demonstrate that learning direct control from optimization enables smooth and robust dynamic target tracking.
items.abstract_zh: 动态目标跟踪要求移动机器人在导航避障的同时保持目标可见，并以平滑、可行的控制运行。在线轨迹优化显式编码这些目标，但需要反复进行数值求解；而基于路点的神经策略将几何预测与控制执行分离。我们提出LECO，一个将跟踪优化转化为直接控制策略离线学习的框架。LECO预测控制序列，并通过可微分运动学模型将其映射为轨迹，从而使轨迹级目标能够直接指导控制学习。衰减式专家引导课程初始化有效的跟踪行为，并逐步将学习转向这些任务目标。在部署时，预测性安全锁检查短时域障碍物间隙，并在预测运动不安全或目标预测无效时调用经典规划与控制回退。在三种仿真障碍物密度下，LECO相对于该指标上最佳竞争方法将均方根线性加加速度降低14.1--31.2%，并取得最高跟踪成功率，每周期计算时间为4.25--5.63 ms。在两个机器人平台上的实验进一步展示了在室内狭窄通道和室外森林环境中的跟踪。这些结果表明，从优化中学习直接控制能够实现平滑且鲁棒的动态目标跟踪。

items.title_en: High-Precision Docking of Differential-Drive Mobile Robots Through LiDAR and Vision Collaboration
items.title_zh: 通过LiDAR与视觉协同的差速驱动移动机器人高精度对接
items.abstract_en: Precise docking requires a differential-drive robot to correct lateral offset through coupled rotation and translation within a short approach distance. We combine global navigation with terminal control using complementary LiDAR and visual observations. A line fitted to the cabinet front gives normal distance and heading. An AprilTag identifies the workstation; intersecting its center ray with the LiDAR plane determines tangential position. Taught observations define the docking reference and can cancel repeatable fixed biases under unchanged mounting and geometry. Lateral pre-alignment and continuous visual servoing coordinate the approach, with predictive stopping to account for low-speed actuation lag. Across two sessions using the same navigation and docking code at five workstations on Robot 2, all 111 tasks completed, including 101 on the first attempt. Relative to the taught observations, onboard longitudinal, lateral and heading residual root-mean-square values were 1.51 mm, 5.93 mm and 0.238 degrees, respectively. Joint acceptance within plus or minus 10 mm per position axis and plus or minus 1 degree heading was 96.4% (107/111), or 95.5% (106/111) with a plus or minus 0.5 degree heading limit.
items.abstract_zh: 精确对接要求差速驱动机器人在短接近距离内通过旋转与平移耦合来校正横向偏移。我们利用互补的LiDAR和视觉观测，将全局导航与终端控制相结合。对柜体正面拟合的直线给出法向距离和航向。AprilTag识别工作站；将其中心射线与LiDAR平面相交确定切向位置。示教观测定义对接参考，并可在安装和几何不变的情况下消除可重复的固定偏差。横向预对准和连续视觉伺服协调接近过程，并通过预测性停止来考虑低速执行滞后。在Robot 2上五个工作站使用相同导航与对接代码的两个会话中，全部111项任务均完成，其中101项首次尝试即完成。相对于示教观测，车载纵向、横向和航向残差均方根值分别为1.51 mm、5.93 mm和0.238度。在每个位置轴±10 mm和航向±1度内的联合接受率为96.4%（107/111），在航向±0.5度限制下为95.5%（106/111）。

items.title_en: JARVIS: From Visual Manuals to Autonomous Robotic Assembly
items.title_zh: JARVIS：从视觉手册到自主机器人装配
items.abstract_en: Visual manuals communicate procedural knowledge through stepwise diagrams, but translating these instructions into reliable long-horizon robotic execution remains challenging. We introduce JARVIS, a method-agnostic benchmark for autonomous visual-manual-guided execution without additional language instructions. JARVIS comprises 236,679 LEGO assembly tasks across 8,987 scenes, with a carefully curated JARVIS-v1 suite of 50 tasks for interactive robotic evaluation. Tasks span varying initial structural complexities and assembly horizons, requiring agents to interpret manuals, ground actions in an evolving workspace, and execute the intended procedure. A structure-aware evaluation protocol captures geometric accuracy, structural relations, construction order, partial progress, and completion. We further introduce JARVIS-agentic, a tool-grounded embodied agent that composes robot primitives into executable programs and uses execution feedback for verification and recovery, without task-specific action trajectories or model parameter updates. Across nine multimodal and reasoning models, task-oriented primitives increase the average assembly score. Performance nevertheless declines sharply with assembly horizon, and execution errors remain difficult to correct. Prior-task experience improves initial performance, while repeated reflection provides inconsistent benefits, highlighting persistent limitations in connecting visual procedural reasoning with reliable physical execution.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉手册通过分步图示传达程序性知识，但将这些指令转化为可靠的长时程机器人执行仍然具有挑战性。我们提出JARVIS，一个与具体方法无关的基准，用于在无额外语言指令条件下进行自主的视觉手册引导执行。JARVIS包含8,987个场景中的236,679个LEGO装配任务，并配有精心策划的JARVIS-v1套件，包含50个用于交互式机器人评估的任务。任务涵盖不同的初始结构复杂度和装配时程，要求智能体解释手册、在不断变化的工作空间中将动作落地，并执行预期流程。结构感知评估协议捕捉几何精度、结构关系、装配顺序、部分进展和完成情况。我们进一步提出JARVIS-agentic，一种基于工具的具身智能体，它将机器人原语组合成可执行程序，并利用执行反馈进行验证和恢复，无需任务特定动作轨迹或模型参数更新。在九个多模态和推理模型上，面向任务的原语提高了平均装配得分。然而性能仍随装配时程增加而急剧下降，执行错误仍难以纠正。先前任务经验可提升初始性能，而重复反思带来的收益不一致，凸显了将视觉程序性推理与可靠物理执行相连接方面的持续局限。

rm.usage: JARVIS是乐高手册引导的长程装配基准与智能体框架，其中“把机器人基元组合成程序、用执行反馈做校验与恢复”的思路可借鉴到工程机器人装配42mm发射机构/能量单元时的失败重试流程；但论文核心是多模态手册理解，RM装配更依赖视觉标签与科技核心位姿伺服，需大幅改造。

items.title_en: DROID-SLAM in the Wild
items.title_zh: DROID-SLAM：在野外环境中
items.abstract_en: We present a robust, real-time RGB SLAM system that handles dynamic environments by leveraging differentiable Uncertainty-aware Bundle Adjustment. Traditional SLAM methods typically assume static scenes, leading to tracking failures in the presence of motion. Recent dynamic SLAM approaches attempt to address this challenge using predefined dynamic priors or uncertainty-aware mapping, but they remain limited when confronted with unknown dynamic objects or highly cluttered scenes where geometric mapping becomes unreliable. In contrast, our method estimates per-pixel uncertainty by exploiting multi-view visual feature inconsistency, enabling robust tracking and reconstruction even in real-world environments. The proposed system achieves state-of-the-art camera poses and scene geometry in cluttered dynamic scenarios while running in real time at around 10 FPS. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个鲁棒的实时RGB SLAM系统，通过利用可微的不确定性感知光束法平差来处理动态环境。传统SLAM方法通常假设静态场景，在存在运动时会导致跟踪失败。近期动态SLAM方法尝试使用预定义动态先验或不确定性感知建图来应对这一挑战，但在面对未知动态物体或高度杂乱、几何建图变得不可靠的场景时仍受限。相比之下，我们的方法利用多视图视觉特征不一致性估计逐像素不确定性，即使在真实世界环境中也能实现鲁棒跟踪与重建。所提出系统在杂乱的动态场景中实现最先进的相机位姿和场景几何，同时以约10 FPS实时运行。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git。
items.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026

items.title_en: Noise Mitigation Methods for Digital Visible Light Communication
items.title_zh: 数字可见光通信的噪声抑制方法
items.abstract_en: Visible Light Communication (VLC) using Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) has gained attention due to its low power consumption, long lifetime, and fast response. However, VLC suffers from optical noise generated by ambient light sources such as fluorescent lamps, which leads to waveform distortion and increased bit error rates (BER). In this paper, we propose two noise reduction methods for Digital Visible Light Communication (DVLC) systems. The first method exploits the periodic nature of interference caused by AC-powered-line illumination and reduces interference by subtracting sampled noise waveforms from the received signal. Second, inspired by Active Noise Control (ANC) techniques, an additional photodiode is introduced for noise reception, and subtraction circuits are employed to attenuate noise in real time. Experimental results show that both methods improve BER performance compared with conventional receivers, with the ANC-inspired approach achieving superior performance under all tested conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 使用发光二极管（LED）的可见光通信（VLC）因其低功耗、长寿命和快速响应而受到关注。然而，VLC受到荧光灯等环境光源产生的光学噪声影响，导致波形失真和误码率（BER）升高。本文针对数字可见光通信（DVLC）系统提出两种降噪方法。第一种方法利用交流供电线路照明所造成干扰的周期性，通过从接收信号中减去采样噪声波形来降低干扰。第二种方法受主动噪声控制（ANC）技术启发，引入额外光电二极管接收噪声，并采用减法电路实时衰减噪声。实验结果表明，与常规接收机相比，两种方法均改善了BER性能，其中受ANC启发的方法在所有测试条件下取得更优性能。

rm.usage: 针对交流供电照明引起的环境光噪声给出两种抑制方案（周期噪声波形相减、仿ANC的额外光电二极管+减法电路），可直接参考用于机库与空中机器人之间可见光链路在场地灯光下的解码提BER；前提是接收端采用光电二极管而非相机，且调制光源须是允许的额外通信LED，不能对七颗航行外观灯做调制。

items.title_en: Symbol Rate Maximization in Rolling-Shutter OCC: Design and Implementation Considerations
items.abstract_en: Optical Camera Communication (OCC) systems can take advantage of the row-by-row scanning process of rolling-shutter cameras to capture the fast variations of light intensity coming from Visible Light Communication (VLC) LED-based transmitters. In order to study the maximum data rate that is feasible in such kind of OCC systems, this paper presents its equivalent digital communication system model in which the rolling-shutter camera is modeled as a rectangular matched-filter whose time width is equal to the exposure time of the camera, followed by a sampling process at the pixel row sweep rate of the camera. Based on the proposed rolling-shutter camera model, the maximum symbol rate that such OCC systems can support is experimentally demonstrated, and the impact of imperfect time synchronization between the VLC transmitter and the rolling-shutter OCC receiver is characterized in the form of Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI). The equivalent three-tap channel model that results from this process is experimentally validated and the generated ISI is compensated with the use of linear equalization in reception. Simulation and experimental results show a strong correlation between them, demonstrating that the proposed approach can be used to make the OCC system work at the Nyquist sampling rate, which is equivalent to the pixel row sweep rate of the rolling-shutter camera used in reception.
items.title_zh: 卷帘快门OCC中的符号速率最大化：设计与实现考量
items.abstract_zh: 光学相机通信（OCC）系统可利用卷帘快门相机的逐行扫描过程，捕获可见光通信（VLC）LED发射机光强的快速变化。为研究此类OCC系统可实现的最大数据速率，本文将卷帘快门相机等效为时间宽度等于曝光时间的矩形匹配滤波器，其后按相机像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而建立等效数字通信系统模型。基于该模型，实验验证了系统可支持的最大符号速率，并将VLC发射机与OCC接收机之间时间同步不完美的影响刻画为符号间干扰（ISI）。实验验证了由此得到的等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端采用线性均衡补偿产生的ISI。仿真与实验结果高度吻合，表明该方法可使OCC系统工作在奈奎斯特采样速率，即接收所用卷帘快门相机的像素行扫描速率。
items.highlight_zh: 将卷帘快门相机建模为矩形匹配滤波器，实现奈奎斯特速率传输
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：可见光通信中，用普通卷帘快门相机当接收机（即OCC）时，相机的逐行扫描恰好能记录LED光强的快速明暗变化。但这类系统的速率上限到底是多少、受什么限制，此前缺乏系统分析。

二、用了什么方法：作者把相机等效成通信系统中的“矩形匹配滤波器”——其积分时间就是相机曝光时间，之后以像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而得到一个可与经典数字通信理论对接的等效模型。在此模型下，作者实验测出了可支持的最大符号速率，并把发射端与接收端时间不同步造成的后果，统一刻画为符号间干扰（ISI），进而推出一个等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端用线性均衡加以补偿。

三、有什么结果：仿真与实测结果高度一致，验证了三抽头信道模型的正确性；线性均衡能有效消除失配带来的ISI，使系统在奈奎斯特速率下工作，也就是恰好等于相机像素行扫描速率——即每个像素行承载一个符号，不留冗余。

四、为何重要：这给出了OCC系统速率设计的“理论天花板”与工程做法。过去设计者常靠降低速率来躲避同步误差，本文说明只要建模正确、接收端做均衡，就能把相机扫描速率用满，为高速相机通信的实用化提供了可操作的准则。

optical_review.reason_zh: 2026年的滚动快门OCC模型与实验研究曝光积分、行采样和不同步导致的码间干扰，适合评估普通相机接收LED信息时的速率与均衡方案。
optical_review.limitations_zh: 需确认相机支持滚动快门并能控制曝光；文中实验使用专用LED、USRP和测量设备，不能将实验带宽直接套到机载相机；未核验公开代码，arXiv仅注明已投稿ICC。

items.title_en: LuxTac: A Flexible, Scalable, and Open-Source Optical Taxel Array with Distributed Three-Axis Force Sensing for Tactile Robot Learning
items.title_zh: LuxTac：一种用于触觉机器人学习的柔性、可扩展、开源且具备分布式三轴力感知的光学触觉像素阵列
items.abstract_en: Low-cost tactile arrays have made touch a practical input for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs sense only pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. To solve this problem, we present LuxTac, a flexible, scalable optical taxel array, about 3.5 mm thick and built from off-the-shelf parts. Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so the back-scattered LED light falls monotonically with local indentation depth. The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing, and one with colored walls that encodes the local shear in the color of the returned light, with no camera, magnets, or bump overlay, making LuxTac, to our knowledge, the first optical taxel array to resolve shear at individual taxels. Characterized with an automated CNC indenter and a six-axis force/torque sensor, the normal cartridge responds linearly to force ($R^2$ = 0.999) from 104 mN to at least 5.8 N, with 2.0% repeatability, 5.9% hysteresis, and a taxel-to-taxel variation of 6-10% after normalization. With the shear cartridge, per-taxel models estimate the three-axis force at every taxel; across three indenter shapes and nine held-out sessions, the summed estimates reach $R^2$ = 0.96/0.96/0.92 in x/y/z, each taxel's estimate 0.92/0.93/0.94, and the median shear-direction error is 4.8 degrees. Adding LuxTac pressure readings to an Action Chunking Transformer policy substantially improves peg-in-hole success over a vision-only baseline. Design files, code, and videos are available at https://luxtac.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 低成本触觉阵列使触觉成为机器人学习的一种实用输入，但压阻式设计仅感知压力，而同时可解析剪切力的基于相机的传感器又过于笨重，难以在夹爪上铺满。为解决此问题，我们提出 LuxTac，一种柔性、可扩展的光学触觉像素阵列，厚度约 3.5 mm，由现成部件构建。每个触觉像素是一个数字 RGBC 光数字转换器，位于半透明白色硅胶层下，并由不透明黑色薄膜覆盖，因此背散射 LED 光随局部压入深度单调下降。同一块板可接受两种可互换的凝胶盒：普通凝胶盒用于法向感知；带彩色壁的凝胶盒将局部剪切编码到返回光的颜色中，无需相机、磁体或凸点覆盖层，据我们所知，这使 LuxTac 成为首个在单个触觉像素上解析剪切力的光学触觉像素阵列。使用自动 CNC 压头和六轴力/力矩传感器进行表征，普通凝胶盒在 104 mN 至至少 5.8 N 范围内对力呈线性响应（R² = 0.999），重复性为 2.0%，滞回为 5.9%，归一化后触觉像素间差异为 6–10%。使用剪切凝胶盒时，逐触觉像素模型估计每个触觉像素处的三轴力；在三种压头形状和九个留出会话中，求和估计在 x/y/z 方向达到 R² = 0.96/0.96/0.92，每个触觉像素的估计为 0.92/0.93/0.94，剪切方向误差中位数为 4.8 度。将 LuxTac 压力读数加入 Action Chunking Transformer 策略后，相比仅视觉基线，插孔任务成功率显著提高。设计文件、代码和视频见 https://luxtac.github.io。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cl
items.title_en: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
items.title_zh: Generalized-CVO：基于二阶黎曼优化的快速无对应局部点云配准
items.abstract_en: We propose a fast and correspondence-free local point cloud registration method that leverages geometric surface structure and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) embeddings. The method represents point clouds as continuous functions with point-wise anisotropic kernels that encode local geometry. This formulation improves alignment along surface normals while relaxing alignment along tangential directions. To solve the resulting registration problem, we propose a second-order on-manifold optimization scheme with approximate Riemannian Hessians, achieving a speedup of up to 10x over the first-order solvers used in prior correspondence-free RKHS-based methods. We demonstrate improved frame-to-frame LiDAR and RGB-D tracking accuracy across diverse indoor and outdoor datasets. On a LiDAR tracking registration task in the driving domain, we achieve a reduction of >55% in both translational and rotational drift in challenging feature-sparse environments. On object registration benchmarks, we show improved robustness over ICP-based methods and further gains when refining global initialization, particularly under moderate misalignment.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种快速且无对应的局部点云配准方法，利用几何表面结构和再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）嵌入。该方法将点云表示为具有逐点各向异性核的连续函数，这些核编码局部几何。该形式改善了沿表面法向的对齐，同时放宽了沿切向方向的对齐。为求解所得配准问题，我们提出一种采用近似黎曼Hessian的二阶流形优化方案，相较于先前无对应RKHS方法中使用的一阶求解器，实现最高10倍的加速。我们在多样化的室内和室外数据集上展示了帧到帧LiDAR和RGB-D跟踪精度的提升。在驾驶领域的LiDAR跟踪配准任务中，我们在具有挑战性的特征稀疏环境中将平移和旋转漂移均降低超过55%。在物体配准基准上，我们展示了相较于基于ICP的方法更好的鲁棒性，并且在精化全局初始化时获得进一步增益，尤其是在中等程度失配下。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object T
items.title_en: An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 一种用于视觉目标跟踪的高效Token压缩框架
items.abstract_en: Refining visual representations by eliminating their internal feature-level redundancy is crucial for simultaneously optimizing the performance and computational cost of models in visual tracking. To enhance their performance, many contemporary Transformer-based trackers leverage a larger number of historical template frames to capture richer spatio-temporal cues. However, this strategy leads to a massive number of input visual tokens. This creates two critical issues: it imposes a quadratic computational burden and can also degrade the tracker's overall performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a compress-then-interact tracking framework, ETCTrack, that learns to efficiently compress template tokens from historical template frames into a robust target representation, moving beyond handcrafted rules. Our method first employs the Adaptive Token Compressor to dynamically construct compact yet highly discriminative template tokens by filtering out redundant visual tokens. These refined template tokens are then processed by our Hierarchical Interaction Encoder to achieve a deep, adaptive interaction with the search features. Refined search features ensure subsequent precise target localization. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. ETCTrack-B224 reduces the number of template tokens by 60%, leading to a 21.4% reduction in MACs with only a 0.4% drop in accuracy. The source code are available at https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack.
items.abstract_zh: 通过消除视觉表示内部的特征级冗余来精炼视觉表示，对于同时优化视觉跟踪模型的性能和计算成本至关重要。为提升性能，许多当代基于Transformer的跟踪器利用更多历史模板帧来捕获更丰富的时空线索。然而，这一策略会导致输入视觉Token数量巨大。这带来两个关键问题：造成二次计算负担，并且还可能降低跟踪器的整体性能。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一种先压缩后交互的跟踪框架ETCTrack，它学习将历史模板帧中的模板Token高效压缩为鲁棒的目标表示，超越手工设计的规则。我们的方法首先采用自适应Token压缩器，通过滤除冗余视觉Token来动态构建紧凑且高度判别性的模板Token。随后，这些精炼后的模板Token由我们的分层交互编码器处理，以与搜索特征实现深度、自适应的交互。精炼后的搜索特征确保后续精确的目标定位。在七个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的跟踪器。ETCTrack-B224将模板Token数量减少60%，使MACs降低21.4%，而精度仅下降0.4%。源代码见 https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack。
items.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026
